  - `fn worker_path() -> io::Result<PathBuf>`: `std::env::current_exe()?.with_file_name(format!("lazymkv-ocr{}", std::env::consts::EXE_SUFFIX))`, the sibling the engine starts too (design 10.7).

  `run` takes `args[0]` as the subcommand: `-h` or `--help` prints `usage: lazymkv-dev <line>` for each `USAGE` line to `out` and returns 0; `read` writes `guard native` to `out` and returns `read_with(native_guard().as_ref(), system_host().as_ref(), &args[1..], out, err)`; the other five go to private functions of the same shape over `ctx`; no argument or another word is `usage_error(err, "ocr-trial", "ocr-trial inventory|read|rows|f-records|summary|parity ...", "the first argument is one of inventory, read, rows, f-records, summary, parity")`. Every flag is parsed with `Args` (each subcommand declares exactly the flags of its `USAGE` line; `--stream` is a whole number of 0 or more and `--clear-max` a whole number through `py_int`, else `argument --<flag>: invalid int value: '<text>'`; a missing required flag is `the following arguments are required: --<flag>`); relative paths go through `ctx.abs`, and `read_with` takes them as given. Every file a subcommand writes goes through `lazymkv_platform::write_atomic` after `fs::create_dir_all` of its parent, whole, after every check has passed.

  `inventory` (design 10.9 step 1, B2, T5-R24): the label is `--rec`'s last component and the slug its parent's. It counts the frames as the files `s<n>\f-*.png` under `--text`; the Tesseract records as `read_jsonl` of `<text>\sub-<n>.ocr.jsonl` (missing: `missing: sub-<n>.ocr.jsonl (the Tesseract reading)`); the F reading as the records with a `frame` in `<text>\ocrs-s<n>.jsonl`, or `none`; the evidence as the first file that exists of `<text>\evidence.mks` (`the dataset copy`), the path under the top-level key `evidence` of `<rec>\subs-ocr\summary.json` read UTF-8 with or without a byte order mark (`the staging path summary.json names`), and `<staging>\<slug>\<label>\evidence.mks` (`the phase 0 staging layout`), else `missing: evidence.mks (no dataset copy, no path in summary.json, none in the phase 0 staging layout)`; the events as `packet_events` of `<rec>\subs\sub-<n>.packets.json` with `Rule::default().CLEAR_MAX_BYTES` (missing: `missing: subs/sub-<n>.packets.json (the packet list)`); with no frame and no F reading, `missing: s<n>/f-*.png and ocrs-s<n>.jsonl (parity cannot be judged on this track)`. `R' run` when frames > 0; `F exists` when the F reading has a record. The `missing:` lines come in that order, all of them, and then exit 1; else the count line, `--where`'s file, and exit 0.

  `read_with` (design 10.9 step 3, 10.8's clock, T5-R44): one positional (the evidence file) and the four flags; then, in this order, `--out` is created (`fs::create_dir_all`) and refused when it holds any entry (`end not started: --out already holds files; the trial reads each track once, into an empty folder`, exit 1, nothing started); the events are `packet_events(<packets>, clear_max).len()` (a file that does not read: `end not started: <file name>: <error>`); it prints `events <m> cap <time_cap_s(m) with one decimal> s`; it builds `ToolCtx { guard, host, limits: &Limits::from_settings(&Settings::default()), cancel: CancelToken::default(), on_output: &|_: OutputStream, _: &str| {}, on_progress: &|_: f64| {} }` (no worker line reaches the output, design 10.12), takes `started = host.now_ms()`, and calls `run_worker(&ctx, &worker_path()?, &ocr_args(&evidence, stream, clear_max, &out), &capture, Duration::from_secs_f64(time_cap_s(m)))`, where `capture` is `--out` with `.capture.txt` added to its last component (beside the folder, never in it); `Err(e)` prints `end not started: {e}`. After the run it prints the wall line from `host.now_ms() - started`, then: `Read` reads `<out>\sub-<n>.run.json` with `read_run_json` and prints the run.json line and `end Read` (exit 0; a run.json that does not read prints `end Read, but sub-<n>.run.json: <error>`, exit 1); `TimedOut` prints `end TimedOut: ` and `cap_reason(cap, whole_records(<out>\sub-<n>.ocr.jsonl, empty when absent).len(), m)`; `Refused`, `ArgumentError` and `Exited` print `end <variant>: ` and `end_reason(&end)`; `Cancelled` prints `end Cancelled`; each exits 1.

  `rows` (arm R', design 10.9): the `f-*.png` files of the folder in name order, frame k the k-th; none is `no f-*.png in the frames folder`, exit 1. `Ocr::load()` once, timed as `load_ms`. Pass 1 reads each frame with `read_png_grey` and keeps only its `Option<Rows>` (`rows(&c.image)` of `crop(&frame)`); `median = median_line_height` over the kept `Rows`. Pass 2 reads each frame again: no crop gives `{"frame": k, "file": name, "lines": [], "method": null, "trigger": null, "ms": {"prepare": a, "lines": 0.0, "detect": null, "recognize": 0.0}}` (a blank frame); else `trigger(&rows, median, &crop, frame.height)` picks `Ocr::detect(&crop.image)` (method `detector`, the trigger's number, `ms.detect` and `ms.recognize` from `Detected`) or `Ocr::recognize(&crop.image, &line_boxes(&crop.image, &rows))` (method `rows`, trigger null, `ms.detect` null), each record's key order frame, file, lines, method, trigger, ms. The last line is `{"summary": {"frames", "blank", "rows", "detector": [four counts], "load_ms", "ms_total", "wall_ms"}}`. A PNG or an ocrs error is `<file name>: <error>`, exit 1, nothing written. Two passes keep one frame in memory at a time.

  `f-records` (design 10.9 step 4, R6-phase0-27, T5-R24): `--in`'s records with a `frame` (the summary line dropped), each joined by frame number to the entry of `<rec>\subs-ocr\sub-<n>.frames.json` (read UTF-8 with or without a byte order mark); the output record is `frame`, `file`, `t` (when the entry has it), `pts` (when the entry has it) and `lines` (the input's array, or `[]`), compact, one per line in the input's order; a frame the file lacks is `frame <k> is not in sub-<n>.frames.json`, one with neither time `frame <k> has neither t nor pts in sub-<n>.frames.json`, the first such frame stopping the run with exit 1 and no file. Its line counts the records, those with a non-empty `lines` and those with a `pts`.

  `summary` (design 10.9 step 3, the numbers-only `summary.json` of `subs-ocr-engine`): for each `<dir>\sub-<m>.run.json`, `m` ascending, `StreamSummary { n: m, codec: <rec>\subs\index.json's codec for n = m, else "unknown", outcome: StreamOutcome::Read(read_run_json(..)), exit: Some(0), wall_ms: <its wall_ms>, with_text, lines, markers }` with the three counts from `text_counts` of `<dir>\sub-<m>.ocr.jsonl` (missing: `sub-<m>.ocr.jsonl is missing beside sub-<m>.run.json`, exit 1); `summary_json` of them to `<dir>\summary.json`. No run.json is `no sub-<n>.run.json in --dir`, exit 1. Rows 4 and 5 share one folder, so each `read` step rewrites the whole file.

  `parity` (design 10.9 "Parity passes", P34, R6-phase0-34 and 35): `arm` over `--f` and over `--r`, then `parity` with `Rule::default()`. `parity`'s rules, every number through `py_fixed(x, 3)`:
  - Per stream `n` of the runs' tracks, in order, the report lines `s<n> <tag> F <m>` and `s<n> <tag> R <m>`, where `<m>` is `CUE <a> LABEL <a> CHEV <a> M <a> SO <a> CS <a> ODD <a> NOTE <a> CAPS_CUE <a> caps_style <b> class <c> readable <b> letter_events <x> wordlike <x> lang <l> shares <name> <x> ...` (the shares in `Measures.shares`' order) or `not read`.
  - A stream read in one arm only: `s<n>: read F <yes | no> R <yes | no>`. For a stream read in both, one difference per unequal count, in the order CUE, LABEL, CHEV, M, SO, CS, ODD, NOTE, CAPS_CUE: `s<n>: <KEY> F <a> R <b>`; then `s<n>: caps_style F <a> R <b>`, `s<n>: class F <a> R <b>` (`Class::as_str`), `s<n>: readable F <a> R <b>`, `s<n>: lang F <a> R <b>` when unequal; then the thresholds, each value against its thresholds in this order, the first that separates the two arms giving `s<n>: <key> F <a> R <b> on two sides of <t>`: `letter_events` against `READ_LETTER_EVENTS` (`>=`), `wordlike` against `READ_WORDLIKE` (`>=`), `share en` against `EN_MIN` (`>=`) and `EN_MAX_OTHER` (`<=`), and `share <other>` for each other share against `OTHER_MIN` (`>=`).
  - The report line `s<n>: F against R, events <m>, exact <k>, cer mean <x> (reported only)` over the events of stream `n` where either arm has lines, each compared as `norm_text(lines, english)` (english for the tags `eng` and `en`): `exact` counts equal texts, `cer mean` is `exact_mean` of `cer(a, b)` (design 10.9 step 4's character error rate and exact-match share; ocr-compare's own pairing by frame number cannot pair arm F's frames with arm R's events).
  - Per pair `(a, b)` of F's `analysis.pairs`, matched to R's by `(a, b)`: the report line `pair s<a> s<b> F CB <x>/<y> R CB <x>/<y>` (`none` for None); a pair in one arm only, `pair s<a> s<b>: in F only` or `in R only`; for each direction (`cb.0` named `s<a> in s<b>`, `cb.1` named `s<b> in s<a>`), None against a number gives `pair s<a> s<b>: CB <dir> F <x | none> R <x | none>`, and two numbers the first threshold that separates them of `CB_DIFF` (`<=`), `CB_SAME` (`>=`), `CB_SUBSET_BACK` (`<`) and `CB_SUBSET_IN` (`>=`): `pair s<a> s<b>: CB <dir> F <x> R <y> on two sides of <t>` (R6-phase0-35's bands).
  - Per stream `n` of the union of both `analysis.decide` maps: the report line `s<n> decision F <role> <review | -> <note | -> R <role> <review | -> <note | ->` (`Role::as_str`), and the same text after `s<n>: decision ` as a difference when the two differ.
  - `lines` holds the report lines in the order above, `differences` the differences in that order.

After `the_platform_ignored_script_parses_and_runs_one_session_of_platform_tests`:

```rust
/// Design part 10.9 (Rulings T5-R45, T5-R62): the OCR trial's desktop-session script reads the rows from
/// trial-tracks.txt, lets a slug or a label reach only a path or a check, sets RTEN_NUM_THREADS=3 for arm R' alone and
/// runs no build. It is read here, and parsed on Windows; it never runs in a test.
#[test]
fn the_engine_ocr_trial_script_parses_sets_rten_num_threads_for_rows_and_prints_numbers_only() {
    let script = PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("..").join("..").join("scripts").join("phase0").join("engine-ocr-trial.ps1");
    let text = fs::read_to_string(&script).unwrap_or_else(|error| panic!("{}: {error}", script.display()));
    for needle in [
        "[Parameter(Mandatory)][ValidateSet('inventory', 'read', 'rows', 'compare', 'f3')][string]$Step",
        r#"$Tracks = "$P0\trial-tracks.txt""#,
        "$ClearMax = 64",
        "$env:RTEN_NUM_THREADS = '3'",
        "Remove-Item Env:RTEN_NUM_THREADS",
        "'--clear-max', [string]$ClearMax",
        "subs-ocr-engine",
        "Assert-Quiet",
        "'RESULT ok'",
    ] {
        assert!(text.contains(needle), "engine-ocr-trial.ps1 lacks: {needle}");
    }
    let code: Vec<&str> = text.lines().map(str::trim).filter(|line| !line.starts_with('#')).collect();
    for absent in ["cargo build", "cargo test", "cargo run", "write-host", "ocrs-trial.exe", "makemkvcon64.exe"] {
        assert!(!code.iter().any(|line| line.to_ascii_lowercase().contains(absent)), "engine-ocr-trial.ps1 runs or prints {absent}");
    }
    let allowed = [
        "[string]$Slug = ''", "[string]$Label = ''", "if ($Slug -and ", "if ($Label -and ", "$rows += [pscustomobject]@{",
        "$rec = ", "$text = ", "$engineOut = ", "$title = @(", "$f3Dir = ",
    ];
    for line in code.iter().filter(|line| {
        let lower = line.to_ascii_lowercase();
        lower.contains("slug") || lower.contains("label")
    }) {
        assert!(allowed.iter().any(|start| line.starts_with(start)), "a slug or a label reaches more than a path or a check: {line}");
    }
    #[cfg(windows)]
    {
        assert!(text.is_ascii(), "Windows PowerShell 5.1 reads a file without a byte order mark in the system code page");
        let errors = parse_errors(&script);
        assert!(errors.is_empty(), "{errors}");
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 12: Write the script.** Create `scripts/phase0/engine-ocr-trial.ps1`, ASCII with LF (line feed) line ends, as every script in `scripts/phase0/` is kept:

```powershell
# The OCR (optical character recognition) trial's desktop-session steps (design part 10.9; pull request 5, Tasks 10
# and 12; the notes' B2 and calls 8 and 19; Rulings T5-R24, T5-R25, T5-R44, T5-R45, T5-R62). One run does one step for
# one row of design 10.9's table, named by its row number only: the row's slug, label and stream are line <row> of
# C:\lazymkv\phase0\trial-tracks.txt (git-ignored, outside the repository: six lines <slug>/<label>/s<n> in row order,
# Task 11), and -Slug, -Label and -Stream, when given, must equal them. The log names rows, never a slug or a label;
# a system error's message may name a path, so an evidence line quotes only the row and the step. Subtitle text stays
# on the share and in this script's work folder on C:, which every run deletes, whatever happened.
#   inventory  step 1: lazymkv-dev ocr-trial inventory (counts of frames, Tesseract records, arm F's reading,
#              evidence.mks and events); a missing input stops the trial and goes to the owner (B2)
#   read       step 3, arm R: evidence.mks copied to C: before timing, lazymkv-dev ocr-trial read (the sibling
#              lazymkv-ocr.exe through the native guard, below normal, RTEN_NUM_THREADS=3, the engine's cap), the copy
#              deleted; the records, run.json and crops copied to $TuningData\<slug>\<label>\subs-ocr-engine\ and its
#              numbers-only summary.json written
#   rows       step 3, arm R': phase 0's frames copied to C:, lazymkv-dev ocr-trial rows with RTEN_NUM_THREADS=3, the
#              records copied to subs-ocr-engine\rows-s<n>.jsonl
#   compare    step 4, once per title under its first row (rows 4 and 5 run as -Row 4): the records of arms F and R'
#              given their times by f-records, then parity of F against R (the verdict's half) and of F against R'
#              (reported only)
#   f3         F3 (report only, T5-R25): retune --subtitles over arm R's text, through a tree on C: deleted afterwards
# Build first over SSH: scripts/box.sh "cargo build --release --locked -p lazymkv-ocr -p lazymkv-dev --features
# lazymkv-dev/ocr-trial"; this script builds nothing. Stop the engine (lazymkvctl stop) before read and rows.
# Usage: scripts/phase0/job.sh engine-ocr-trial.ps1 <log name> -Step <step> -Row <k> [-Slug <slug> -Label <label> -Stream <n>]
#        scripts/phase0/job.sh engine-ocr-trial.ps1 <log name> -Step f3 [-Evidence <dir>]
# The capture files of each run (numbers on standard output; standard error may name a path) stay in
# C:\lazymkv\phase0\tmp\engine-ocr\logs\<step>-<row>\. The last line is "RESULT ok" or "RESULT FAILED: <reason>";
# after a failure the script throws.
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory)][ValidateSet('inventory', 'read', 'rows', 'compare', 'f3')][string]$Step,
    [int]$Row = 0,
    [string]$Slug = '',
    [string]$Label = '',
    [int]$Stream = -1,
    [string]$Evidence = ''
)
. C:\lazymkv\src\scripts\phase0\env.ps1

$DEV = 'C:\lazymkv\target\release\lazymkv-dev.exe'
$WORKER = 'C:\lazymkv\target\release\lazymkv-ocr.exe'
$Tracks = "$P0\trial-tracks.txt"
$Spec = 'C:\lazymkv\src\docs\superpowers\specs\2026-10-04-lazymkv-design.md'
$ClearMax = 64
$MaxBytes = 2GB

# The six rows of trial-tracks.txt; a line of another form stops the run, naming its number only.
function Get-TrialRows {
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Tracks)) { throw "missing $Tracks (Task 11 writes it)" }
    $lines = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $Tracks -Encoding UTF8 -ErrorAction Stop | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() } | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' })
    if ($lines.Count -ne 6) { throw "$Tracks holds $($lines.Count) rows, not 6" }
    $rows = @()
    for ($k = 0; $k -lt 6; $k++) {
        $m = [regex]::Match($lines[$k], '^([a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*)/([a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*)/s(\d+)$')
        if (-not $m.Success) { throw "line $($k + 1) of $Tracks is not of the form name/name/s<n>" }
        $rows += [pscustomobject]@{ row = $k + 1; slug = $m.Groups[1].Value; label = $m.Groups[2].Value; stream = [int]$m.Groups[3].Value }
    }
    $rows
}

# Design 10.9 step 3: nothing else runs while an arm is timed.
function Assert-Quiet {
    $busy = @(Get-Process -Name 'lazymkv-engine', 'makemkvcon64', 'makemkvcon', 'cargo', 'rustc', 'ocrs-trial' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
    if ($busy.Count -gt 0) {
        throw "these run, so nothing is timed: $(($busy | ForEach-Object { $_.ProcessName } | Sort-Object -Unique) -join ', '); stop the engine with lazymkvctl stop and wait for the rest"
    }
}

# lazymkv-dev ocr-trial through lazymkv-capture: its standard output reaches the log and $Logs\<Name>.txt, its
# standard error only $Logs\<Name>.txt.stderr. Sets $TrialExit.
function Invoke-Trial([string]$Name, [string[]]$Arguments) {
    & $CAP record --out "$Logs\$Name.txt" -- $DEV ocr-trial @Arguments
    $script:TrialExit = $LASTEXITCODE
}

# Copies one file and checks its size.
function Copy-Checked([string]$From, [string]$To, [string]$What) {
    Copy-Item -LiteralPath $From -Destination $To -ErrorAction Stop
    if ((Get-Item -LiteralPath $To).Length -ne (Get-Item -LiteralPath $From).Length) { throw "the copy of $What differs in size from its source" }
}

$work = $null
try {
    foreach ($exe in @($CAP, $DEV, $WORKER)) { if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $exe)) { throw "missing $exe; build it first (see the header)" } }
    $all = Get-TrialRows
    $Logs = "$P0\tmp\engine-ocr\logs\$Step-$Row"
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Logs) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $Logs -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction Stop }
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $Logs -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null
    $work = "$P0\tmp\engine-ocr\work-$Step-$Row"
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $work) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $work -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction Stop }
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $work -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null
    if (Test-Path Env:RTEN_NUM_THREADS) { Remove-Item Env:RTEN_NUM_THREADS }

    if ($Step -eq 'f3') {
        # T5-R25: <tmp>\<slug>\<label>\subs-ocr\sub-<n>.ocr.jsonl holds copies of arm R's records.
        foreach ($t in $all) {
            $f3Dir = "$work\$($t.slug)\$($t.label)\subs-ocr"
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $f3Dir -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null
            $engineOut = "$TuningData\$($t.slug)\$($t.label)\subs-ocr-engine"
            Copy-Checked "$engineOut\sub-$($t.stream).ocr.jsonl" "$f3Dir\sub-$($t.stream).ocr.jsonl" "row $($t.row)'s arm R records"
        }
        $source = if ($Evidence) { $Evidence } else { $Recordings }
        "f3: retune --subtitles over arm R's text of rows 1 to 6"
        & $CAP record --out "$Logs\retune.txt" -- $DEV retune --subtitles --evidence $source --text $work --spec $Spec
        "retune exit $LASTEXITCODE"
    } else {
        if ($Row -lt 1 -or $Row -gt 6) { throw "-Row must be 1 to 6 for the step $Step" }
        $track = $all[$Row - 1]
        if ($Slug -and $Slug -cne $track.slug) { throw "row ${Row}: -Slug differs from line $Row of trial-tracks.txt" }
        if ($Label -and $Label -cne $track.label) { throw "row ${Row}: -Label differs from line $Row of trial-tracks.txt" }
        if ($Stream -ge 0 -and $Stream -ne $track.stream) { throw "row ${Row}: -Stream differs from line $Row of trial-tracks.txt" }
        $n = $track.stream
        $rec = "$Recordings\$($track.slug)\$($track.label)"
        $text = "$TuningData\$($track.slug)\$($track.label)\subs-ocr"
        $engineOut = "$TuningData\$($track.slug)\$($track.label)\subs-ocr-engine"
        $inventoryArgs = @('inventory', '--rec', $rec, '--text', $text, '--stream', [string]$n, '--staging', $Staging, '--where', "$work\where.txt")
        "row ${Row}: step $Step, stream s$n"

        if ($Step -eq 'inventory') {
            Invoke-Trial 'inventory' $inventoryArgs
            if ($TrialExit -ne 0) { throw "row ${Row}: an input is missing (B2); the owner decides whether the trial stands without this row" }
        }

        if ($Step -eq 'read') {
            Assert-Quiet
            if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath "$engineOut\sub-$n.ocr.jsonl") -or (Test-Path -LiteralPath "$engineOut\s$n")) {
                throw "row ${Row}: subs-ocr-engine already holds stream s$n; the trial reads each track once (design 10.9)"
            }
            Invoke-Trial 'inventory' $inventoryArgs
            if ($TrialExit -ne 0) { throw "row ${Row}: an input is missing (B2)" }
            $source = Get-Content -LiteralPath "$work\where.txt" -Encoding UTF8 -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object -First 1
            $copy = "$work\evidence.mks"
            Copy-Checked $source $copy 'evidence.mks'
            "row ${Row}: evidence.mks copied to C: before timing, $((Get-Item -LiteralPath $copy).Length) bytes"
            Invoke-Trial 'read' @('read', $copy, '--stream', [string]$n, '--clear-max', [string]$ClearMax, '--packets', "$rec\subs\sub-$n.packets.json", '--out', "$work\r")
            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $copy -Force -ErrorAction Stop
            "row ${Row}: the copy of evidence.mks deleted"
            if ($TrialExit -ne 0) { throw "row ${Row}: arm R did not read the stream (its end line says why); a kill fails the trial (T5-R44)" }
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $engineOut -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null
            foreach ($name in @("sub-$n.ocr.jsonl", "sub-$n.run.json")) { Copy-Checked "$work\r\$name" "$engineOut\$name" $name }
            Copy-Item -LiteralPath "$work\r\s$n" -Destination "$engineOut\s$n" -Recurse -ErrorAction Stop
            $crops = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath "$work\r\s$n" -Filter 'f-*.png' -File -ErrorAction Stop).Count
            $copied = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath "$engineOut\s$n" -Filter 'f-*.png' -File -ErrorAction Stop).Count
            if ($copied -ne $crops) { throw "row ${Row}: $copied of $crops crops were copied" }
            Invoke-Trial 'summary' @('summary', '--dir', $engineOut, '--rec', $rec)
            if ($TrialExit -ne 0) { throw "row ${Row}: summary.json was not written" }
            "row ${Row}: arm R copied to subs-ocr-engine: sub-$n.ocr.jsonl, sub-$n.run.json, $crops crops, summary.json"
        }

        if ($Step -eq 'rows') {
            Assert-Quiet
            $frames = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath "$text\s$n" -Filter 'f-*.png' -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object Name)
            if ($frames.Count -eq 0) {
                "row ${Row}: R' not run (no frame set, B2)"
            } else {
                if (Test-Path -LiteralPath "$engineOut\rows-s$n.jsonl") { throw "row ${Row}: subs-ocr-engine already holds rows-s$n.jsonl; the trial reads each track once (design 10.9)" }
                $bytes = [long]($frames | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum).Sum
                if ($bytes -gt $MaxBytes) { throw "row ${Row}: the frames hold $bytes bytes, more than the 2 GB the copy may put on C:" }
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path "$work\frames" -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null
                foreach ($f in $frames) { Copy-Item -LiteralPath $f.FullName -Destination "$work\frames" -ErrorAction Stop }
                $copied = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath "$work\frames" -Filter 'f-*.png' -File -ErrorAction Stop).Count
                if ($copied -ne $frames.Count) { throw "row ${Row}: $copied of $($frames.Count) frames were copied to C:" }
                "row ${Row}: $($frames.Count) frames copied to C:, $bytes bytes; RTEN_NUM_THREADS=3 for arm R'"
                $env:RTEN_NUM_THREADS = '3'
                try { Invoke-Trial 'rows' @('rows', "$work\frames", '--out', "$work\rows-s$n.jsonl") }
                finally { Remove-Item Env:RTEN_NUM_THREADS -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
                if ($TrialExit -ne 0) { throw "row ${Row}: arm R' stopped (exit $TrialExit)" }
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $engineOut -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null
                Copy-Checked "$work\rows-s$n.jsonl" "$engineOut\rows-s$n.jsonl" "rows-s$n.jsonl"
                "row ${Row}: arm R' copied to subs-ocr-engine: rows-s$n.jsonl"
            }
        }

        if ($Step -eq 'compare') {
            $title = @($all | Where-Object { $_.slug -ceq $track.slug -and $_.label -ceq $track.label })
            $first = ($title | Measure-Object -Property row -Minimum).Minimum
            if ($first -ne $Row) { throw "row $Row is compared with row $first, its title's first row" }
            $shown = ($title | ForEach-Object { $_.row }) -join ' and '
            foreach ($sub in @('f', 'rprime')) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path "$work\$sub" -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null }
            $everyRprime = $true
            foreach ($t in $title) {
                $m = $t.stream
                Invoke-Trial "f-records-$m" @('f-records', '--rec', $rec, '--stream', [string]$m, '--in', "$text\ocrs-s$m.jsonl", '--out', "$work\f\sub-$m.ocr.jsonl")
                if ($TrialExit -ne 0) { throw "row $($t.row): arm F's records could not be given their times (B2)" }
                if (Test-Path -LiteralPath "$engineOut\rows-s$m.jsonl") {
                    Invoke-Trial "rprime-records-$m" @('f-records', '--rec', $rec, '--stream', [string]$m, '--in', "$engineOut\rows-s$m.jsonl", '--out', "$work\rprime\sub-$m.ocr.jsonl")
                    if ($TrialExit -ne 0) { throw "row $($t.row): the records of arm R' could not be given their times" }
                } else {
                    $everyRprime = $false
                    "row $($t.row): R' not run"
                }
            }
            "rows ${shown}: parity of F against R"
            Invoke-Trial 'parity-r' @('parity', '--rec', $rec, '--f', "$work\f", '--r', $engineOut)
            if ($TrialExit -eq 2) { throw "rows ${shown}: parity could not read an arm (parity-r.txt.stderr in the logs folder)" }
            if ($everyRprime) {
                "rows ${shown}: parity of F against R' (reported only)"
                Invoke-Trial 'parity-rprime' @('parity', '--rec', $rec, '--f', "$work\f", '--r', "$work\rprime")
                if ($TrialExit -eq 2) { throw "rows ${shown}: parity could not read arm R' (parity-rprime.txt.stderr in the logs folder)" }
            }
        }
    }
    'RESULT ok'
} catch {
    "RESULT FAILED: $($_.Exception.Message)"
    throw
} finally {
    # No subtitle text stays on C:: the evidence copy, the frames, the arms' records and the worker's capture go.
    if (Test-Path Env:RTEN_NUM_THREADS) { Remove-Item Env:RTEN_NUM_THREADS }
    if ($work -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $work)) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $work -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
}
```

  The worker's capture (`$work\r.capture.txt` and its three siblings, whose standard error can hold text, T5-R57) is in `$work` and goes with it; the logs folder holds only `lazymkv-dev`'s captures, whose standard output is numbers and whose standard error names at most a path.

```powershell
# The decoder goldens of design part 10.4 (pull request 5's Task 11; notes calls 7 and 24): runs the built test
# program of crates/ocr/tests/goldens.rs in the owner's desktop session on the mini PC, the only session that reaches
# the share, so it lives under scripts\phase0\, the only folder run-interactive.ps1 runs, and its output is the log
# C:\lazymkv\phase0\logs\<log name>.txt. It never builds: build the program first over SSH with
# scripts/box.sh cargo test -p lazymkv-ocr --locked --release --test goldens --no-run, whose Executable line names it,
# and run no scripts/box.sh until this job ends, since each sync replaces C:\lazymkv\src.
# The program reads the six trial tracks from C:\lazymkv\phase0\trial-tracks.txt (outside the repository, one
# <slug>/<label>/s<n> line per row of design part 10.9's table, T5-R45) and prints row numbers and counts only.
# Usage: scripts/phase0/job.sh ocr-goldens.ps1 <log name> -Exe C:\lazymkv\target\release\deps\goldens-<hash>.exe
# The last line is "RESULT ok" or "RESULT FAILED: <reason>"; after a failure the script throws.
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Exe
)
. C:\lazymkv\src\scripts\phase0\env.ps1
$Tracks = 'C:\lazymkv\phase0\trial-tracks.txt'
try {
    if ($Exe -notlike 'C:\lazymkv\target\release\deps\goldens-*.exe') { throw '-Exe must be the goldens test program, C:\lazymkv\target\release\deps\goldens-<hash>.exe' }
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Exe)) { throw "missing $Exe; build it over SSH first, as the comment at the top says" }
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Tracks)) { throw "missing $Tracks, one <slug>/<label>/s<n> line per row of design part 10.9's table" }
    # The goldens read these; without any of the first three each test prints "skipped:" and passes. Staging is the
    # last place an evidence file is looked for (R6-phase0-20).
    $env:LAZYMKV_EVIDENCE = $Recordings
    $env:LAZYMKV_OCR_TEXT = $TuningData
    $env:LAZYMKV_OCR_TRACKS = $Tracks
    $env:LAZYMKV_OCR_STAGING = $Staging
    # cmd joins the program's standard error to its standard output, so each skipped: line reaches the log, and
    # Windows PowerShell 5.1 never turns a native standard-error line into an error record.
    cmd /c "$Exe --test-threads=1 --nocapture 2>&1"
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "the goldens exited $LASTEXITCODE" }
    'RESULT ok'
} catch {
    "RESULT FAILED: $($_.Exception.Message)"
    throw
}

```rust
//! The decoder goldens of design part 10.4 on phase 0's six trial tracks (design part 10.9's table; notes calls 7 and
//! 24; T5-R6, T5-R22, T5-R23, T5-R45). They read the recordings through `LAZYMKV_EVIDENCE`, the tuning dataset through
//! `LAZYMKV_OCR_TEXT` and the six tracks through `LAZYMKV_OCR_TRACKS` (one `<slug>/<label>/s<n>` line per row, the
//! file `C:\lazymkv\phase0\trial-tracks.txt` outside the repository), with `LAZYMKV_OCR_STAGING` as the last place an
//! evidence file is looked for (R6-phase0-20); without any of the first three they print `skipped: <reason>` and pass.
//! They run in the owner's desktop session on the mini PC through `scripts/phase0/ocr-goldens.ps1`, the only session
//! that reaches the share, and print row numbers and counts only: never a slug, a label, a path, a file name or any
//! subtitle text (RP21, the notes' rule on titles). Errors name the row and the kind of file, never its path.

use std::collections::BTreeMap;
use std::io::Write;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

use lazymkv_core::recording::files::{read_jsonl, FrameEntry, Packet, SubsIndexEntry};
use lazymkv_core::subtitle::align::load_packets;
use lazymkv_core::subtitle::bitmap::evidence::check_events;
use lazymkv_core::subtitle::bitmap::mkv::{read_stream, SubStream};
use lazymkv_core::subtitle::bitmap::pgs::PgsDecoder;
use lazymkv_core::subtitle::bitmap::prepare::{crop, prepare, Crop, Grey, INK};
use lazymkv_core::subtitle::bitmap::vobsub::decode_vobsub;
use lazymkv_core::subtitle::bitmap::{Bitmap, SubCodec};
use lazymkv_core::subtitle::text::{ocr_records, packet_events, pair_text, Rule};
use lazymkv_ocr::read_png_grey;
use serde_json::Value;

/// The largest grey difference a paired event may show, for ffmpeg's rounding through RGB (design part 10.4, notes
/// call 7); a larger one is a finding for the owner, never a reason to widen it (T5-R23).
const TOLERANCE: u8 = 2;

/// The rows of design part 10.9's table, one line of the tracks file each.
const ROWS: usize = 6;

/// One row of design part 10.9's table as the tracks file names it; `slug` and `label` only build paths.
struct Track {
    row: usize,
    slug: String,
    label: String,
    n: usize,
}

struct Inputs {
    recordings: PathBuf,
    dataset: PathBuf,
    staging: Option<PathBuf>,
    tracks: Vec<Track>,
}

impl Inputs {
    /// `<recordings>/<slug>/<label>`, the track's recording.
    fn recording(&self, track: &Track) -> PathBuf {
        self.recordings.join(&track.slug).join(&track.label)
    }

    /// `<dataset>/<slug>/<label>/subs-ocr`, phase 0's reading in the tuning dataset.
    fn reading(&self, track: &Track) -> PathBuf {
        self.dataset.join(&track.slug).join(&track.label).join("subs-ocr")
    }
}

/// `skipped: <reason>` on standard error, which the test harness does not capture; the notes count it as not run.
fn skip(reason: &str) {
    let _ = std::io::stderr().write_all(format!("skipped: {reason}\n").as_bytes());
}

/// The folder a variable names, when it is set and is a folder.
fn folder(name: &str) -> Option<PathBuf> {
    std::env::var_os(name).map(PathBuf::from).filter(|path| path.is_dir())
}

/// The inputs, or None after the skip line of the first one missing. A tracks file that is not six
/// `<slug>/<label>/s<n>` lines panics naming the line number only.
fn inputs() -> Option<Inputs> {
    let Some(recordings) = folder("LAZYMKV_EVIDENCE") else {
        skip("no recordings: give LAZYMKV_EVIDENCE, the phase 0 recordings folder (scripts/phase0/ocr-goldens.ps1 sets it in the desktop session)");
        return None;
    };
    let Some(dataset) = folder("LAZYMKV_OCR_TEXT") else {
        skip("no tuning dataset: give LAZYMKV_OCR_TEXT, the folder holding <slug>/<label>/subs-ocr/ (scripts/phase0/ocr-goldens.ps1 sets it)");
        return None;
    };
    let Some(list) = std::env::var_os("LAZYMKV_OCR_TRACKS").map(PathBuf::from).filter(|path| path.is_file()) else {
        skip("no trial tracks: give LAZYMKV_OCR_TRACKS, a file of one <slug>/<label>/s<n> line per row of design part 10.9's table");
        return None;
    };
    let text = std::fs::read_to_string(&list)
        .unwrap_or_else(|error| panic!("the tracks file could not be read ({:?})", error.kind()));
    let mut tracks = Vec::new();
    for (i, line) in text.lines().map(str::trim).filter(|line| !line.is_empty()).enumerate() {
        let parts: Vec<&str> = line.split('/').collect();
        let n = match parts.as_slice() {
            [slug, label, stream] if !slug.is_empty() && !label.is_empty() => {
                stream.strip_prefix('s').and_then(|n| n.parse::<usize>().ok())
            }
            _ => None,
        };
        let n = n.unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("line {} of the tracks file is not <slug>/<label>/s<n>", i + 1));
        tracks.push(Track { row: i + 1, slug: parts[0].to_string(), label: parts[1].to_string(), n });
    }
    assert_eq!(tracks.len(), ROWS, "the tracks file holds {} rows, not design part 10.9's {ROWS}", tracks.len());
    Some(Inputs { recordings, dataset, staging: folder("LAZYMKV_OCR_STAGING"), tracks })
}

/// A file's bytes; the error names the row and what the file is, never its path (RP21).
fn bytes(row: usize, what: &str, path: &Path) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
    std::fs::read(path).map_err(|error| format!("row {row}: {what} could not be read ({:?})", error.kind()))
}

/// A UTF-8 text without its byte order mark, which Windows PowerShell 5.1's `Set-Content -Encoding UTF8` writes.
fn text(row: usize, what: &str, path: &Path) -> Result<String, String> {
    let text = String::from_utf8(bytes(row, what, path)?).map_err(|_| format!("row {row}: {what} is not UTF-8"))?;
    Ok(text.trim_start_matches('\u{feff}').to_string())
}

/// A JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) value; the error gives the line only, since serde_json's text can quote the
/// file.
fn json(row: usize, what: &str, path: &Path) -> Result<Value, String> {
    serde_json::from_str(&text(row, what, path)?)
        .map_err(|error| format!("row {row}: {what} does not parse at line {}", error.line()))
}

/// ffprobe's number, written as a string or a number.
fn number(value: Option<&Value>) -> Option<f64> {
    match value? {
        Value::String(text) => text.parse().ok(),
        other => other.as_f64(),
    }
}

/// The track's evidence file and where it was found: the dataset's copy, else the path the recording's
/// `subs-ocr/summary.json` names under `evidence`, else `<staging>/<slug>/<label>/evidence.mks` (B2, R6-phase0-18,
/// R6-phase0-20).
fn evidence(inputs: &Inputs, track: &Track) -> Result<(Vec<u8>, &'static str), String> {
    let row = track.row;
    let copy = inputs.reading(track).join("evidence.mks");
    if copy.is_file() {
        return Ok((bytes(row, "the dataset's evidence.mks", &copy)?, "dataset"));
    }
    let summary = inputs.recording(track).join("subs-ocr").join("summary.json");
    if summary.is_file() {
        let named = json(row, "summary.json", &summary)?.get("evidence").and_then(Value::as_str).map(PathBuf::from);
        if let Some(named) = named.filter(|path| path.is_file()) {
            return Ok((bytes(row, "the evidence.mks summary.json names", &named)?, "summary"));
        }
    }
    let staged = inputs.staging.as_ref().map(|staging| staging.join(&track.slug).join(&track.label).join("evidence.mks"));
    if let Some(staged) = staged.filter(|path| path.is_file()) {
        return Ok((bytes(row, "the staged evidence.mks", &staged)?, "staging"));
    }
    Err(format!("row {row}: no evidence.mks in the dataset, at the path summary.json names or in the staging folder"))
}

/// The recording's `subs/sub-<n>.packets.json`, read as the text rule reads it.
fn packets(inputs: &Inputs, track: &Track, n: usize) -> Result<Vec<Packet>, String> {
    let name = format!("sub-{n}.packets.json");
    let path = inputs.recording(track).join("subs").join(&name);
    load_packets(&text(track.row, &name, &path)?, &name).map_err(|error| format!("row {}: {error}", track.row))
}

/// The stream's codec as printed; another codec is an error naming its codec ID.
fn codec_word(row: usize, stream: &SubStream) -> Result<&'static str, String> {
    match stream.codec {
        Some(SubCodec::Pgs) => Ok("PGS"),
        Some(SubCodec::VobSub) => Ok("VobSub"),
        None => Err(format!("row {row}: the stream is {}, not PGS or VobSub", stream.codec_id)),
    }
}

/// One row of the size golden: its printed line and whether it passes (design part 10.3, notes call 24, K1).
fn size_row(inputs: &Inputs, track: &Track) -> Result<(String, bool), String> {
    let row = track.row;
    let (file, source) = evidence(inputs, track)?;
    let stream = read_stream(&file, track.n).map_err(|error| format!("row {row}: {error}"))?;
    let codec = codec_word(row, &stream)?;
    let listed = packets(inputs, track, track.n)?;
    let (mut times, mut sizes) = (0, 0);
    for (block, packet) in stream.blocks.iter().zip(&listed) {
        if number(packet.pts_time.as_ref()).map_or(true, |pts| (pts - block.pts).abs() > 0.0005) {
            times += 1;
        }
        if number(packet.size.as_ref()).map(|size| size as u64) != Some(block.size) {
            sizes += 1;
        }
    }
    let clear_max = Rule::default().CLEAR_MAX_BYTES;
    let events: Vec<(f64, u64)> =
        stream.blocks.iter().filter(|block| block.size as i64 > clear_max).map(|block| (block.pts, block.size)).collect();
    let check = check_events(&events, &listed, clear_max).err();
    // The whole file: every subtitle stream the recording's subs/index.json lists, for K1's two sums.
    let index: Vec<SubsIndexEntry> = serde_json::from_value(json(row, "index.json", &inputs.recording(track).join("subs").join("index.json"))?)
        .map_err(|_| format!("row {row}: index.json is not a list of streams"))?;
    let (mut block_bytes, mut packet_bytes) = (0u64, 0u64);
    for entry in &index {
        let n = usize::try_from(entry.n).map_err(|_| format!("row {row}: index.json lists stream {}", entry.n))?;
        let other = read_stream(&file, n).map_err(|error| format!("row {row}: stream s{n}: {error}"))?;
        block_bytes += other.blocks.iter().map(|block| block.size).sum::<u64>();
        packet_bytes += packets(inputs, track, n)?.iter().filter_map(|packet| number(packet.size.as_ref())).map(|size| size as u64).sum::<u64>();
    }
    let passes = stream.blocks.len() == listed.len() && times == 0 && sizes == 0 && check.is_none();
    let line = format!(
        "row {row}: s{} {codec}, evidence from the {source}, {} bytes; {} blocks, {} packets listed, {times} time and {sizes} size differences, {} events, cross-check {}; all {} subtitle streams: {block_bytes} block bytes, {packet_bytes} packet bytes",
        track.n,
        file.len(),
        stream.blocks.len(),
        listed.len(),
        events.len(),
        check.unwrap_or_else(|| "ok".to_string()),
        index.len(),
    );
    Ok((line, passes))
}

/// The canvas phase 0 drew the stream on: summary.json's `canvas` for the stream (`ocr-subs.ps1` line 230), else what
/// `ocr-subs.ps1` line 162 computes from `subs-ocr/streams.json` (the stream's width x height, else 1920x1080).
fn canvas(inputs: &Inputs, track: &Track) -> Result<((u32, u32), &'static str), String> {
    let row = track.row;
    let folder = inputs.recording(track).join("subs-ocr");
    let summary = json(row, "summary.json", &folder.join("summary.json"))?;
    let named = summary
        .get("streams")
        .and_then(Value::as_array)
        .into_iter()
        .flatten()
        .find(|entry| entry.get("n").and_then(Value::as_u64) == Some(track.n as u64))
        .and_then(|entry| entry.get("canvas"))
        .and_then(Value::as_str);
    if let Some(size) = named {
        let parsed = size.split_once('x').and_then(|(w, h)| Some((w.parse().ok()?, h.parse().ok()?)));
        return parsed.map(|size| (size, "summary")).ok_or_else(|| format!("row {row}: summary.json's canvas is not <width>x<height>"));
    }
    let probe = json(row, "streams.json", &folder.join("streams.json"))?;
    let stream = probe
        .get("streams")
        .and_then(Value::as_array)
        .into_iter()
        .flatten()
        .filter(|entry| entry.get("codec_type").and_then(Value::as_str) == Some("subtitle"))
        .nth(track.n)
        .ok_or_else(|| format!("row {row}: streams.json has no subtitle stream s{}", track.n))?;
    let side = |key: &str| stream.get(key).and_then(Value::as_u64).filter(|side| *side > 0).map(|side| side as u32);
    Ok(match (side("width"), side("height")) {
        (Some(width), Some(height)) => ((width, height), "streams"),
        _ => ((1920, 1080), "default"),
    })
}

/// The prepared frame on phase 0's canvas: equal sizes give the frame unchanged; otherwise a white canvas with the
/// frame's pixels from its top-left corner, and the row's line prints both sizes.
fn on_canvas(frame: &Grey, (width, height): (u32, u32)) -> Grey {
    if (frame.width, frame.height) == (width, height) {
        return frame.clone();
    }
    let mut pixels = vec![255u8; (width * height) as usize];
    for y in 0..height.min(frame.height) {
        for x in 0..width.min(frame.width) {
            pixels[(y * width + x) as usize] = frame.pixels[(y * frame.width + x) as usize];
        }
    }
    Grey { width, height, pixels }
}

/// (left, top, right, bottom), inclusive, of the pixels at grey 127 or darker (design part 10.5); None without one.
fn dark_box(image: &Grey) -> Option<(u32, u32, u32, u32)> {
    let mut found: Option<(u32, u32, u32, u32)> = None;
    for (i, &grey) in image.pixels.iter().enumerate() {
        if grey > INK {
            continue;
        }
        let (x, y) = (i as u32 % image.width, i as u32 / image.width);
        found = Some(match found {
            None => (x, y, x, y),
            Some((left, top, right, bottom)) => (left.min(x), top.min(y), right.max(x), bottom.max(y)),
        });
    }
    found
}

/// A crop's place and size on its frame (T5-R6).
fn crop_box(crop: &Crop) -> (u32, u32, u32, u32) {
    (crop.left, crop.top, crop.image.width, crop.image.height)
}

/// The largest grey difference between two frames of one size.
fn largest_difference(a: &Grey, b: &Grey) -> u8 {
    a.pixels.iter().zip(&b.pixels).map(|(x, y)| x.abs_diff(*y)).max().unwrap_or(0)
}

#[derive(Default)]
struct Tally {
    paired: usize,
    unpaired_events: usize,
    extra_frames: usize,
    box_mismatches: usize,
    frame_size: usize,
    crop_mismatches: usize,
    largest: u8,
}

/// One row of the decoder golden: its printed line and whether it passes (design part 10.4, notes call 7).
fn decode_row(inputs: &Inputs, track: &Track) -> Result<(String, bool), String> {
    let row = track.row;
    let (file, _) = evidence(inputs, track)?;
    let stream = read_stream(&file, track.n).map_err(|error| format!("row {row}: {error}"))?;
    let codec = codec_word(row, &stream)?;
    let clear_max = Rule::default().CLEAR_MAX_BYTES;
    let blocks: Vec<_> = stream.blocks.iter().filter(|block| block.size as i64 > clear_max).collect();
    let mut events = packet_events(&packets(inputs, track, track.n)?, clear_max).map_err(|error| format!("row {row}: {error}"))?;
    if blocks.len() != events.len() {
        return Err(format!("row {row}: the reader gives {} events and the packet list {}; the size golden names the difference", blocks.len(), events.len()));
    }
    let (canvas, canvas_from) = canvas(inputs, track)?;
    // Phase 0's text frames as pair_text sees them, each carrying its frame file in place of its lines, so that
    // pair_text's own pairing (order on equal counts, else time within 0.30 s) names each event's frames.
    let reading = inputs.reading(track);
    let records_name = format!("sub-{}.ocr.jsonl", track.n);
    let records = read_jsonl(&text(row, &records_name, &reading.join(&records_name))?)
        .map_err(|_| format!("row {row}: {records_name} does not parse"))?;
    let frames_name = format!("sub-{}.frames.json", track.n);
    let frames: Vec<FrameEntry> = serde_json::from_value(json(row, &frames_name, &inputs.recording(track).join("subs-ocr").join(&frames_name))?)
        .map_err(|_| format!("row {row}: {frames_name} is not a list of frames"))?;
    let counts: BTreeMap<i64, Option<i64>> = frames.iter().map(|frame| (frame.frame, frame.lines)).collect();
    let mut text_frames = Vec::new();
    for record in &records {
        let kept = ocr_records(std::slice::from_ref(record), &counts).map_err(|_| format!("row {row}: {records_name} does not read"))?;
        if let Some(mut kept) = kept.into_iter().next() {
            kept.lines = vec![record.file.clone().ok_or_else(|| format!("row {row}: a record of {records_name} names no file"))?];
            text_frames.push(kept);
        }
    }
    let (method, unpaired_frames) = pair_text(&mut events, &text_frames);
    let frame_dir = reading.join(format!("s{}", track.n));
    let mut pgs = PgsDecoder::new();
    let mut tally = Tally::default();
    let mut video = (0, 0);
    for (i, (block, event)) in blocks.iter().zip(&events).enumerate() {
        let decoded: Result<Bitmap, String> = match (stream.codec, stream.idx.as_ref()) {
            (Some(SubCodec::Pgs), _) => pgs.decode(&block.payload),
            (_, Some(idx)) => decode_vobsub(&block.payload, idx),
            (_, None) => Err("the VobSub track has no idx header".to_string()),
        };
        let bitmap = decoded.map_err(|error| format!("row {row}: event {i}: {error}"))?;
        video = (bitmap.video_width, bitmap.video_height);
        if event.lines.is_empty() {
            tally.unpaired_events += 1;
            continue;
        }
        tally.paired += 1;
        let prepared = prepare(&bitmap);
        let drawn = on_canvas(&prepared, canvas);
        let worker = crop(&prepared).map(|crop| crop_box(&crop));
        for (j, name) in event.lines.iter().enumerate() {
            tally.extra_frames += usize::from(j > 0);
            let frame = read_png_grey(&bytes(row, "a phase 0 frame", &frame_dir.join(name))?)
                .map_err(|_| format!("row {row}: event {i}: its frame is not a grey PNG"))?;
            if (frame.width, frame.height) != canvas {
                tally.frame_size += 1;
                tally.box_mismatches += 1;
                continue;
            }
            if dark_box(&drawn) != dark_box(&frame) {
                tally.box_mismatches += 1;
            }
            if worker != crop(&frame).map(|crop| crop_box(&crop)) {
                tally.crop_mismatches += 1;
            }
            tally.largest = tally.largest.max(largest_difference(&drawn, &frame));
        }
    }
    let passes = tally.box_mismatches == 0 && tally.crop_mismatches == 0 && tally.largest <= TOLERANCE;
    let line = format!(
        "row {row}: {codec}, {} events, {} frames, {} text frames paired by {}: {} paired events, {} unpaired events, {unpaired_frames} unpaired frames, {} extra frames; {} box mismatches ({} of frame size), {} crop mismatches, largest difference {}; canvas {}x{} from {canvas_from}, video {}x{}",
        events.len(),
        records.len(),
        text_frames.len(),
        method.as_str(),
        tally.paired,
        tally.unpaired_events,
        tally.extra_frames,
        tally.box_mismatches,
        tally.frame_size,
        tally.crop_mismatches,
        tally.largest,
        canvas.0,
        canvas.1,
        video.0,
        video.1,
    );
    Ok((line, passes))
}

/// Design part 10.3 and notes call 24 (K1): on each trial track the reader's blocks equal the recording's packet
/// list in number, order (each pts within 0.0005 s of the listed `pts_time`) and size once the content encoding is
/// undone, and Task 6's `check_events` accepts its events; never weakened to count and order alone.
#[test]
fn the_reader_sizes_equal_the_recorded_packet_lists_on_the_trial_tracks() {
    let Some(inputs) = inputs() else { return };
    let mut failed = Vec::new();
    for track in &inputs.tracks {
        let (line, passes) = size_row(&inputs, track).unwrap_or_else(|error| (error, false));
        println!("{line}");
        if !passes {
            failed.push(track.row);
        }
    }
    assert!(failed.is_empty(), "rows {failed:?} differ from their packet lists in number, order or size (notes call 24: a stop)");
}

/// Design part 10.4 and notes call 7 (T5-R5, T5-R6, T5-R22, T5-R23): every event of each trial track is decoded and
/// prepared; each event paired with a phase 0 text frame has the frame's dark-pixel box exactly, the crop the worker
/// would read equals the crop of the frame, and no pixel differs by more than 2 grey levels. Unpaired events and
/// frames are counted and printed, not failed (T5-R22).
#[test]
fn the_decoders_match_phase_0s_frames_on_the_trial_tracks() {
    let Some(inputs) = inputs() else { return };
    let mut failed = Vec::new();
    for track in &inputs.tracks {
        let (line, passes) = decode_row(&inputs, track).unwrap_or_else(|error| (error, false));
        println!("{line}");
        if !passes {
            failed.push(track.row);
        }
    }
    assert!(
        failed.is_empty(),
        "rows {failed:?} have a box or crop mismatch, a difference above {TOLERANCE} grey levels or an error (design part 10.4, notes call 7)"
    );
}
```

The decisions this file makes, which the steps below rely on: an event paired with several frames (time pairing, a frame per 0.25 s tick of phase 0's 4 frames per second canvas) is compared with each of them and its further frames are counted as `extra frames`; a phase 0 frame of another size than the canvas counts as a box mismatch (`of frame size`); a decoding error on any event fails its row (design part 10.8: the stream would be unread).

**Tier and risk:** the controller (opus) with the owner; risk high: any fail of parity or speed, any kill and any missing input stops the pull request and goes to the owner with the numbers (B3), and the run cannot be repeated without the owner's leave (design part 10.9 "One trial").

This task runs the optical character recognition (OCR) trial of design part 10.9 once, on the mini PC, and commits only its verdict. It writes no code and no test: the trial's code is Task 10's `lazymkv-dev ocr-trial` and `scripts/phase0/engine-ocr-trial.ps1`, and its build is Task 11's pushed commit (T5-R54). `BOX '<cmd>'` is `ssh -o BatchMode=yes "$LAZYMKV_BOX" '<cmd>'`, with `LAZYMKV_BOX` from `scripts/phase0/box.env`. ```rust
    /// The working folder a `print-cwd` child of `spawn` reports, canonical, so a symbolic link (macOS's `/var`) or a
    /// short name (a Windows runner's `RUNNER~1`) compares equal (T5-R37).
    pub(crate) fn reported_cwd(guard: &dyn ProcessGuard, spawn: &Spawn) -> std::path::PathBuf {
        let mut child = guard.spawn(spawn).unwrap();
        let mut out = String::new();
        child.take_stdout().read_to_string(&mut out).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(child.wait().unwrap(), Some(0), "{out}");
        let line = out.lines().find_map(|line| line.strip_prefix("cwd ")).unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("no cwd line in {out}"));
        std::fs::canonicalize(line).unwrap()
    }

    /// A `Spawn` with `cwd` set starts its child in that folder, for any runner (T5-R37).
    pub(crate) fn check_runs_in_its_cwd(guard: &dyn ProcessGuard) {
        let scratch = lazymkv_core::testsupport::Scratch::new("spawn-cwd");
        let spawn = Spawn { cwd: Some(scratch.0.clone()), ..helper("print-cwd") };
        assert_eq!(reported_cwd(guard, &spawn), std::fs::canonicalize(&scratch.0).unwrap());
    }

    /// A `Spawn` without `cwd` starts its child where this process runs, as every spawn did before (T5-R37).
    pub(crate) fn check_runs_where_it_did(guard: &dyn ProcessGuard) {
        let spawn = helper("print-cwd");
        assert_eq!(spawn.cwd, None);
        assert_eq!(reported_cwd(guard, &spawn), std::fs::canonicalize(std::env::current_dir().unwrap()).unwrap());
    }
```

```rust
//! The ffmpeg driver against the stand-in (design parts 5.3, 5.7 step 10a; R5-code-27; Ruling S12).

use std::fs;
use std::io;
use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::sync::Mutex;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

use lazymkv_core::ipc::{OutputStream, CANCELLED};
use lazymkv_core::testsupport::{Scratch, ScratchExt};
use lazymkv_engine::testkit::{ci_factor, BusyRetry};
use lazymkv_platform::fakes::FakeHost;
use lazymkv_platform::{GuardedChild, ProcessGuard, Spawn, StdProcessGuard};
use lazymkv_tools::{layouts_args, proxy_check_args, run_ffmpeg, streamhash_args, with_suffix, CancelToken, Limits, ToolCtx};

const EXE: &str = std::env::consts::EXE_SUFFIX;
const HASHES: &str = "0,a,MD5=0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef\n1,a,MD5=fedcba9876543210fedcba9876543210\n";
const LAYOUTS: &str = "Standard channel layouts:\nNAME           DECOMPOSITION\nmono           FC\nstereo         FL+FR\n5.1            FL+FR+FC+LFE+BL+BR\n";

fn stand_in(scratch: &Scratch, stem: &str, scenario: &str, files: &[(&str, &[u8])]) -> PathBuf {
    let program = scratch.0.join("tools").join(format!("{stem}{EXE}"));
    scratch.write(&format!("tools/{stem}.json"), scenario);
    for (name, bytes) in files {
        scratch.write(&format!("tools/{name}"), bytes);
    }
    fs::copy(env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_fake-tool"), &program).unwrap();
    program
}

/// The stand-in's runner, keeping every `Spawn` it is given.
#[derive(Default)]
struct Recording {
    spawns: Mutex<Vec<Spawn>>,
}

impl ProcessGuard for Recording {
    fn spawn(&self, spawn: &Spawn) -> io::Result<Box<dyn GuardedChild>> {
        self.spawns.lock().unwrap().push(spawn.clone());
        BusyRetry(StdProcessGuard).spawn(spawn)
    }
}

/// Runs `f` with a context over `guard`; a kill pauses 300 ms (S56).
fn run<R>(guard: &dyn ProcessGuard, cancel: &CancelToken, f: impl FnOnce(&ToolCtx) -> R) -> R {
    let host = FakeHost::new("2026-10-23", 1_800_000_000);
    let limits = Limits { header: Duration::from_secs(120), scan: Duration::from_secs(60),
        exit_wait: Duration::from_secs(60), after_kill: Duration::from_millis(300) };
    let on_output = |_: OutputStream, _: &str| {};
    let on_progress = |_: f64| {};
    let ctx = ToolCtx { guard, host: &host, limits: &limits, cancel: cancel.clone(), on_output: &on_output,
        on_progress: &on_progress };
    f(&ctx)
}

#[test]
fn run_ffmpeg_runs_below_normal_in_its_working_folder() {
    let scratch = Scratch::new("ffmpeg-cwd");
    // arg_after "md5" names the relative file streamhash.txt, which the stand-in creates in its own working folder.
    let program = stand_in(&scratch, "ffmpeg", r#"{"responses":[{"args_contain":["-f","streamhash"],
        "creates":[{"arg_after":"md5","copy_from":"hashes.txt"}]}]}"#, &[("hashes.txt", HASHES.as_bytes())]);
    let work = scratch.0.join("work").join("levels-j-t00");
    fs::create_dir_all(&work).unwrap();
    let out = scratch.0.join("job").join("t00").join("streamhash-ffmpeg.txt");
    fs::create_dir_all(out.parent().unwrap()).unwrap();
    let args = streamhash_args(&scratch.0.join("staging").join("raw.mkv"), "streamhash.txt");
    let guard = Recording::default();
    let ran = run(&guard, &CancelToken::default(), |ctx| run_ffmpeg(ctx, &program, &args, &out, Some(&work)));
    assert_eq!(ran.unwrap().unwrap().exit_code, Some(0));
    assert_eq!(fs::read_to_string(work.join("streamhash.txt")).unwrap(), HASHES);
    let spawns = guard.spawns.lock().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(spawns.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!((spawns[0].program.as_path(), spawns[0].args.as_slice()), (program.as_path(), args.as_slice()));
    assert!(spawns[0].below_normal, "step 10a's ffmpeg runs below normal (design part 5.3)");
    assert_eq!(spawns[0].cwd.as_deref(), Some(work.as_path()));
    assert!(spawns[0].env.is_empty(), "{:?}", spawns[0].env);
    for suffix in ["", ".stderr", ".timing.jsonl", ".exit.json"] {
        assert!(with_suffix(&out, suffix).is_file(), "no capture file {}{suffix}", out.display());
    }
}

#[test]
fn run_ffmpeg_returns_the_layouts_table_on_standard_output() {
    let scratch = Scratch::new("ffmpeg-layouts");
    let program = stand_in(&scratch, "ffmpeg", r#"{"responses":[{"args_contain":["-layouts"],"stdout":"layouts.txt"}]}"#,
        &[("layouts.txt", LAYOUTS.as_bytes())]);
    let out = scratch.0.join("work").join("levels-j-t00").join("layouts.txt");
    fs::create_dir_all(out.parent().unwrap()).unwrap();
    let guard = Recording::default();
    let ran = run(&guard, &CancelToken::default(), |ctx| run_ffmpeg(ctx, &program, &layouts_args(), &out, None));
    assert_eq!(ran.unwrap().unwrap().stdout, LAYOUTS.as_bytes());
    assert_eq!(fs::read_to_string(&out).unwrap(), LAYOUTS);
    assert_eq!(guard.spawns.lock().unwrap()[0].cwd, None);
}

#[test]
fn a_failed_run_names_the_program_and_its_exit_code() {
    let scratch = Scratch::new("ffmpeg-exit");
    let ffmpeg = stand_in(&scratch, "ffmpeg", r#"{"responses":[{"args_contain":["-layouts"],"exit_code":1}]}"#, &[]);
    let ffprobe = stand_in(&scratch, "ffprobe", r#"{"responses":[{"args_contain":["proxy-check.json"],"exit_code":1}]}"#, &[]);
    let work = scratch.0.join("work").join("levels-j-t00");
    fs::create_dir_all(&work).unwrap();
    let guard = Recording::default();
    let cancel = CancelToken::default();
    let ffmpeg_ran = run(&guard, &cancel, |ctx| run_ffmpeg(ctx, &ffmpeg, &layouts_args(), &work.join("layouts.txt"), None));
    assert_eq!(ffmpeg_ran.unwrap().unwrap_err(), "ffmpeg exited with code 1");
    let check = proxy_check_args("audio-proxy.mka.partial");
    let ffprobe_ran = run(&guard, &cancel, |ctx| run_ffmpeg(ctx, &ffprobe, &check, &work.join("proxy-check.txt"), Some(&work)));
    assert_eq!(ffprobe_ran.unwrap().unwrap_err(), "ffprobe exited with code 1");
}

#[test]
fn a_cancelled_run_is_cancelled_and_pauses_after_the_kill() {
    let scratch = Scratch::new("ffmpeg-cancel");
    let program = stand_in(&scratch, "ffmpeg",
        r#"{"responses":[{"args_contain":["-f","streamhash"],"stdout":"hashes.txt","hang_after_line":0}]}"#,
        &[("hashes.txt", HASHES.as_bytes())]);
    let work = scratch.0.join("work").join("levels-j-t00");
    fs::create_dir_all(&work).unwrap();
    let cancel = CancelToken::default();
    let delay = Duration::from_millis(200) * ci_factor();
    let later = cancel.clone();
    std::thread::spawn(move || {
        std::thread::sleep(delay);
        later.cancel();
    });
    let started = Instant::now();
    let args = streamhash_args(&scratch.0.join("raw.mkv"), "streamhash.txt");
    let ran = run(&Recording::default(), &cancel, |ctx| run_ffmpeg(ctx, &program, &args, &work.join("ffmpeg.txt"), Some(&work)));
    assert_eq!(ran.unwrap().unwrap_err(), CANCELLED);
    assert!(started.elapsed() >= delay + Duration::from_millis(300), "the driver returned before limits.after_kill (S56)");
}

/// The ffprobe call 24's cross-check runs: `LAZYMKV_TEST_FFPROBE`, else the first `ffprobe` on `PATH` (K11's lookup
/// for layer 2, with no version floor here).
fn installed_ffprobe() -> Option<PathBuf> {
    if let Some(path) = std::env::var_os("LAZYMKV_TEST_FFPROBE") {
        return Some(PathBuf::from(path));
    }
    let name = exe_name(Tool::Ffprobe);
    std::env::split_paths(&std::env::var_os("PATH")?).map(|dir| dir.join(&name)).find(|path| path.is_file())
}

/// A JSON value of ffprobe's listing as text: its string, else its JSON form.
fn text(value: &Option<serde_json::Value>) -> String {
    match value {
        Some(serde_json::Value::String(text)) => text.clone(),
        Some(other) => other.to_string(),
        None => String::new(),
    }
}

#[test]
fn the_runners_ffprobe_lists_a_zlib_pgs_tracks_inflated_sizes_as_the_reader_does() {
    let Some(ffprobe) = installed_ffprobe() else {
        assert!(std::env::var_os("CI").is_none(), "CI has no ffprobe, so call 24's cross-check cannot run on this runner");
        println!("skipped: no ffprobe (set LAZYMKV_TEST_FFPROBE or put ffprobe on PATH), so call 24's cross-check did not run");
        return;
    };
    let scratch = Scratch::new("cross-check");
    let env = Env::new();
    let palette = [(1u8, [235u8, 128, 128, 255])];
    let payloads: Vec<Vec<u8>> = (0..4u32)
        .map(|k| pgs_display_set((1920, 1080), &[(0, 10, 10, 1900 - 100 * k, 200 + 20 * k, 1)], &palette))
        .collect();
    let sizes: Vec<u64> = payloads.iter().map(|p| p.len() as u64).collect();
    assert!(sizes.windows(2).all(|w| w[0] != w[1]), "the four made-up events need four sizes: {sizes:?}");
    let track = MksTrack { number: 1, kind: 17, codec_id: CODEC_PGS.to_string(), codec_private: Vec::new(),
        language: "eng".to_string(), encoding: MksEncoding::Zlib };
    let times = [1_000i64, 2_500, 4_000, 61_103];
    let blocks: Vec<MksBlock> = times.iter().zip(&payloads).map(|(t, p)| MksBlock::new(1, *t, p.clone())).collect();
    let bytes = mks(&[track], &blocks, &MksShape::default());
    let inflated: u64 = sizes.iter().sum();
    assert!((bytes.len() as u64) < inflated, "the file is {} bytes for {inflated} inflated, so zlib did not apply", bytes.len());
    let evidence = scratch.write_path("staging/j/evidence/t00.mks", &bytes);
    let out = scratch.0.join("job/t00/subs/sub-0.packets.json");
    fs::create_dir_all(out.parent().unwrap()).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(env.run(|ctx| packets(ctx, &ffprobe, &packets_args(0, &evidence), &out)).unwrap(), Ok(()));
    let listed: PacketsFile = serde_json::from_slice(&fs::read(&out).unwrap()).unwrap();
    let by_ffprobe: Vec<(i64, u64)> = listed
        .packets()
        .iter()
        .map(|p| ((text(&p.pts_time).parse::<f64>().unwrap() * 1000.0).round() as i64, text(&p.size).parse().unwrap()))
        .collect();
    let stream = read_stream(&bytes, 0).unwrap();
    let by_reader: Vec<(i64, u64)> = stream.blocks.iter().map(|b| ((b.pts * 1000.0).round() as i64, b.size)).collect();
    assert_eq!(by_reader.iter().map(|r| r.1).collect::<Vec<_>>(), sizes);
    assert_eq!(by_ffprobe, by_reader,
        "call 24: this runner's ffprobe lists other (pts ms, size) pairs than the reader; stop and give the owner both lists");
    println!("cross-check: {} packets, sizes {sizes:?}, equal in number, order and size", by_reader.len());
}
```

The cross-check skips only where no ffprobe is found, at any FFmpeg version (Global Constraints, Tests). On CI (`CI` set, as GitHub Actions sets it) a missing ffprobe fails instead of skipping, because a skip there would hide that call 24's check never ran; every runner installs one (`.github/workflows/ci.yml:42-52`: apt's FFmpeg 6.1 on ubuntu, brew on macos, choco on windows). Its four events are made-up solid rectangles (RP21: no glyph, no font, no byte from the clone).

### Task 14: Step 10's extraction, packet lists and probe-summary.json (spec 6.4 step 10; design 5.7, 10.2 steps 1 and 2; T5-R55, T5-R56)

The engine's ExtractSubtitleEvidence step gains spec 6.4 step 10's first two parts: for each planned title where `step10_runs` holds, mkvmerge writes the subtitle-only evidence file to the staging share, and ffprobe lists each subtitle stream's packets into the job's recording. The task also adds `engine::staged`, the staged, evidence and work paths and the one checked copy every later cross-volume copy uses (T5-R55), and the unit's two-way error, whose staging half waits as AwaitingShare or AwaitingSpace (T5-R56). Nothing here starts the OCR worker: Decide still fails a title that needs step 10 with S32's sentence, which Task 15 removes.

**Tier and risk:** opus (integration: a step's failure classes, a scenario's response order and a copy helper that four later tasks rest on); risk medium: a staging write error fed as Unknown would fail a job that should wait for its share, and a copy helper that renames before its size check would let a torn file into the tuning trees.

**Covers:** R2-decoders-9 (default compression: Task 13's `extract_args` passes no `--compression`), 62 (the counts come from ffprobe's `subs\sub-<n>.packets.json`); R3-worker-11 (no extraction for a title with one English stream); R5-code-21 (the reducer is unchanged: `ProbeDone` still gives `[ExtractSubtitleEvidence, Decide]`, core `job.rs:823-825`), 22 (`needs_step10` stays the one call of `step10_runs`), 29, 30; R6-phase0-10 (`<n>` is the index among the evidence file's subtitle streams), 11 (`subs\index.json`'s seven keys), 13 (every subtitle track of the title, exit 0 or 1 accepted).

Precondition: Task 13 is committed, pushed and green on the three systems (its ffprobe cross-check ran, not skipped, on each runner). This task edits no `Cargo.toml` and no `Cargo.lock`, and nothing under `crates/core/src/subtitle/bitmap/`, `crates/ocr/`, `crates/ocr-models/` or `crates/tools/src/ocr.rs` (T5-R54).

#[cfg(test)]

    use super::*;
    use lazymkv_core::testsupport::{Scratch, ScratchExt};
    use std::fs;

    /// Every file under `dir`, relative, with '/' separators.
    fn files(dir: &Path) -> Vec<String> {
        fn walk(root: &Path, dir: &Path, found: &mut Vec<String>) {
            for entry in fs::read_dir(dir).unwrap() {
                let path = entry.unwrap().path();
                if path.is_dir() {
                    walk(root, &path, found);
                } else {
                    found.push(path.strip_prefix(root).unwrap().to_str().unwrap().replace('\\', "/"));
                }
            }
        }
        let mut found = Vec::new();
        walk(dir, dir, &mut found);
        found.sort();
        found
    }

    #[test]

        let (a, b) = (Scratch::new("staged-from"), Scratch::new("staged-to"));
        let from = a.write_path("evidence.mks", b"lazymkv-test-mks");
        let to = b.0.join("evidence.mks");
        fs::write(b.0.join("evidence.mks.partial"), b"stale").unwrap();
        copy_checked(&from, &to).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(fs::read(&to).unwrap(), b"lazymkv-test-mks");
        assert_eq!(fs::read(&from).unwrap(), b"lazymkv-test-mks");
        assert_eq!(files(&b.0), ["evidence.mks"]);
        let missing = b.0.join("no-folder").join("evidence.mks");
        assert_eq!(copy_checked(&from, &missing).unwrap_err().kind(), io::ErrorKind::NotFound);
        assert!(!b.0.join("no-folder").exists(), "copy_checked creates no folder");

/// Ruling T5-R56 (design part 5.6 step 6, review round 1 of pull request 3, V5): a unit's write error on the staging
/// share waits for the share as a failed rip does, and any other unit failure is Unknown without asking the share.
#[test]
fn a_unit_staging_error_is_classed_by_the_share_check_and_a_failed_one_is_unknown() {
    use lazymkv_core::job::OutputCause;
    let output = |cause| Failure { class: FailureClass::Output, output: Some(cause) };
    let down = || StagingHealth { share_healthy: false, out_of_space: false };
    let staged = unit_result(UnitError::Staging("S/abc-1/evidence: denied".to_string()), down);
    assert_eq!(staged.event, Some(Event::DecisionFailed { failure: output(OutputCause::ShareUnreachable) }));
    assert_eq!(staged.message.as_deref(), Some("S/abc-1/evidence: denied"));
    let full = || StagingHealth { share_healthy: true, out_of_space: true };
    let staged = unit_result(UnitError::Staging("S/abc-1/evidence/t00.mks: no space".to_string()), full);
    assert_eq!(staged.event, Some(Event::DecisionFailed { failure: output(OutputCause::OutOfSpace) }));
    let unasked = || -> StagingHealth { panic!("a failed unit asks no share") };
    let failed = unit_result(UnitError::Failed("mkvmerge exited with code 2".to_string()), unasked);
    assert_eq!(failed.event, Some(Event::DecisionFailed { failure: UNKNOWN }));
    assert_eq!(failed.message.as_deref(), Some("mkvmerge exited with code 2"));
}

```rust
const TWO_SUBS: &str = "movie-direct-two-subs";

/// Inserts movie-direct and waits until its Decide, or the step before it, fed DecisionDone or DecisionFailed; until
/// Task 15 a title that needs step 10 fails there with S32's sentence.
fn until_decided(h: &Harness) -> String {
    h.insert("tok0", "movie-direct");
    let id = format!("{}-1", h.fingerprint("movie-direct").to_ascii_lowercase());
    let decided = |h: &Harness| {
        h.transitions(&id).iter().any(|line| {
            matches!(line.event, Some(Event::DecisionDone { .. }) | Some(Event::DecisionFailed { .. }))
        })
    };
    h.wait("the decision", decided);
    h.settle();
    id
}

/// The arguments of every spawn holding the argument `word` exactly, in order.
fn spawns_with(h: &Harness, word: &str) -> Vec<Vec<String>> {
    h.spawns().into_iter().filter(|s| s.args.iter().any(|a| a == word)).map(|s| s.args).collect()
}

/// `<staging>/<id>/evidence/<KEY>.mks` and the staged raw file `<staging>/<id>/rip/<KEY>/title_t00.mkv`.
fn evidence_and_raw(h: &Harness, id: &str) -> (PathBuf, PathBuf) {
    let job = h.staging().join(id);
    (job.join("evidence").join(format!("{KEY}.mks")), job.join("rip").join(KEY).join("title_t00.mkv"))
}

#[test]
fn step_10_writes_the_evidence_file_the_subtitle_index_and_one_packet_list_per_stream() {
    let h = harness(&[TWO_SUBS], json!({}));
    let id = until_decided(&h);
    let (evidence, raw) = evidence_and_raw(&h, &id);
    assert_eq!(fs::read(&evidence).unwrap(), b"lazymkv-test-mks");
    assert_eq!(spawns_with(&h, "-D"), vec![extract_args(&evidence, &[2, 3], &raw)]);
    assert_eq!(spawns_with(&h, "-select_streams"), vec![packets_args(0, &evidence), packets_args(1, &evidence)]);
    let dir = h.job_dir(&id).join(KEY);
    assert_eq!(fs::read(dir.join("evidence-mkvmerge.txt")).unwrap(), b"#GUI#progress 100%\n");
    for n in 0..2 {
        let packets = dir.join("subs").join(format!("sub-{n}.packets.json"));
        assert_eq!(fs::read(&packets).unwrap(), fs::read(h.tools().join(format!("packets-s{n}.json"))).unwrap());
        assert!(dir.join("subs").join(format!("sub-{n}.packets.json.exit.json")).is_file());
    }
    let index = dir.join("subs").join("index.json");
    assert_eq!(json_of(&index), json!([
        {"n": 0, "track_id": 2, "language": "eng", "codec": "HDMV PGS", "track_name": null, "forced": null, "default": null},
        {"n": 1, "track_id": 3, "language": "eng", "codec": "HDMV PGS", "track_name": null, "forced": null, "default": null}
    ]));
    assert!(fs::read_to_string(&index).unwrap().ends_with("}\n]\n"), "pretty JSON and a final newline");
    let log = fs::read_to_string(h.job_dir(&id).join("job.log")).unwrap();
    assert!(log.contains(&format!("run {KEY}/evidence-mkvmerge.txt: ")), "{log}");
    assert!(log.contains(&format!("ended {KEY}/subs/sub-1.packets.json: exit 0 after ")), "{log}");
}

#[test]
fn mkvmerge_exit_1_is_accepted_and_exit_2_fails_the_decision() {
    let warned = harness(&[TWO_SUBS, "movie-direct-two-subs-extract-warn"], json!({}));
    let id = until_decided(&warned);
    assert_eq!(spawns_with(&warned, "-select_streams").len(), 2);

    let h = harness(&[TWO_SUBS, "movie-direct-two-subs-extract-error"], json!({}));

    assert_eq!(record.message.as_deref(), Some("mkvmerge exited with code 2"));
    assert!(spawns_with(&h, "-select_streams").is_empty());
    let summary = json_of(&h.job_dir(&id).join(KEY).join("probe-summary.json"));

    assert_eq!((&summary["subtitle_tracks"], &summary["evidence_bytes"]), (&json!(2), &Value::Null));
    assert!(!h.job_dir(&id).join(KEY).join("subs").join("index.json").exists());

#[test]
fn a_missing_mkvmerge_waits_as_tool_missing() {
    let h = harness(&[TWO_SUBS], json!({}));
    let mkvmerge = h.tools().join(exe_name(Tool::Mkvmerge));
    // Removed when the probe starts, so the disc phase had it and only step 10 finds it missing.
    h.on_spawn(&["-show_streams"], move || fs::remove_file(&mkvmerge).unwrap());
    let id = run_to(&h, "AwaitingTool");
    h.settle();
    assert_eq!(h.record(&id).state, State::AwaitingTool { return_to: Box::new(State::Inspecting) });
    let found = events(&h, &id);
    let probed = found.iter().position(|e| *e == Event::ProbeDone).expect("the probe ran");
    let missing = found.iter().position(|e| *e == Event::ToolMissing { tool: Tool::Mkvmerge }).unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("no ToolMissing {{ Mkvmerge }}: {found:?}"));
    assert!(probed < missing, "{found:?}");
    assert!(spawns_with(&h, "-select_streams").is_empty());
}

/// Ruling T5-R56: a write error on the staging share during step 10 waits for the share, as RipTitle's does.
#[test]
fn a_staging_share_that_stops_answering_during_the_extraction_waits_as_awaiting_share() {
    let h = harness(&[TWO_SUBS], json!({}));
    h.insert("tok0", "movie-direct");
    h.run_until("Inspecting");
    let id = h.job_ids().pop().unwrap();
    let folder = h.staging().join(&id).join("evidence");
    fs::write(&folder, b"").unwrap(); // a file where the evidence folder goes, so creating it fails
    let staging = h.staging().to_str().unwrap().to_string();
    h.shares().set_reach(&staging, Reach::Unreachable("cable out".into()));
    h.restart();
    h.wait("AwaitingShare", |h| h.state_of(&id) == "AwaitingShare");
    let record = h.record(&id);
    assert_eq!(record.state, State::AwaitingShare { return_to: Box::new(State::Inspecting) });
    let share = Failure { class: FailureClass::Output, output: Some(OutputCause::ShareUnreachable) };
    assert!(events(&h, &id).contains(&Event::DecisionFailed { failure: share }));
    let message = record.message.unwrap();
    assert!(message.starts_with(&format!("{}: ", folder.display())), "{message}");
    assert!(spawns_with(&h, "-D").is_empty());
}

Step 10a is not built yet, so it writes the job.log line `step 10a did not run in this version` (S33) and, when every title is done, returns no event; Decide still fails a title that needs step 10 (S32)." The body:

```rust
fn extract_subtitle_evidence(&self) -> Outcome {
    self.log(STEP10A_NOT_RUN);
    let failed = |failure| Event::DecisionFailed { failure };
    let plan = self.job_plan(failed)?;
    let (scan, typed) = self.planned_scan().map_err(|error| unknown(failed, error))?;
    let mut titles = Vec::new();
    for planned in &plan.titles {
        if self.needs_step10(&scan, &typed, planned).map_err(|error| unknown(failed, error))? {
            titles.push(planned.key.as_str());
        }
    }
    if titles.is_empty() {
        return Ok(StepResult { event: None, message: None });
    }
    let Some(mkvmerge) = self.tool(Tool::Mkvmerge) else {
        return Ok(event(Event::ToolMissing { tool: Tool::Mkvmerge }));
    };
    let Some(ffprobe) = self.tool(Tool::Ffprobe) else {
        return Ok(event(Event::ToolMissing { tool: Tool::Ffprobe }));
    };
    let staging = self.job.settings.staging_root.as_deref().ok_or_else(|| unknown(failed, "staging_root is unset"))?;
    for key in titles {
        let raw = self.staged_file(key).map_err(|error| unknown(failed, error))?;
        let ident = self.staged_ident(key).map_err(|error| unknown(failed, error))?;
        let evidence = evidence_file(staging, self.id, key);
        let label_dir = self.job.job_dir.join(key);
        let extracted = self.ctx(&no_progress, |ctx| {
            step10::extract(ctx, &mkvmerge, &ffprobe, &raw, &ident, &evidence, &label_dir, &|line: &str| self.log(line))
        });
        self.check_cancel()?;
        if let Err(error) = extracted {
            return Ok(unit_result(error, || self.staging_health()));
        }
    }
    Ok(StepResult { event: None, message: None })
}
```
