```rust
    let last_read = spawns.iter().rposition(worker).expect("the worker ran");
    let pass = spawns.iter().position(|s| s.args.iter().any(|a| a == "streamhash")).expect("step 10a ran");
    assert!(last_read < pass, "worker {last_read}, pass {pass}");
    assert!(h.job_dir(&id).join(KEY).join("streamhash.txt").is_file());
}

#[test]
fn the_decision_carries_the_packet_md5s_and_the_measures_of_step_10a() {
    let h = harness(&[], evidence_on());
    let id = run_to(&h, "Filed");
    let doc = json_of(&h.job_dir(&id).join(KEY).join("decide.json"));
    assert_eq!(doc["decision"]["facts"]["md5_streams"], json!([1]));
    assert_eq!(doc["audio"].as_array().unwrap().len(), 1);
    assert_eq!((&doc["audio"][0]["folder"], &doc["audio"][0]["frames"]), (&json!(LEVELS), &json!(5)));
    assert_dev_renders_decide_json(&h, &id);
    let off = harness(&[], json!({}));
    let off_id = run_to(&off, "Filed");
    let off_doc = json_of(&off.job_dir(&off_id).join(KEY).join("decide.json"));
    assert_eq!((&off_doc["decision"]["facts"]["md5_streams"], &off_doc["audio"]), (&json!([1]), &json!([])));
    assert_dev_renders_decide_json(&off, &off_id);
}

#[test]
fn after_a_restart_the_decision_reads_them_back_from_the_job_folder() {
    let first = harness(&[], evidence_on());
    let first_id = run_to(&first, "Filed");
    let expected = json_of(&first.job_dir(&first_id).join(KEY).join("decide.json"));
    let h = harness(&[], evidence_on());
    h.insert("tok0", "movie-direct");
    h.run_until("Decided");
    let id = h.job_ids().pop().unwrap();
    h.restart(); // resume(Decided) runs Decide alone, over read_back_inputs (design part 5.10)
    h.wait("Filed", |h| h.state_of(&id) == "Filed");
    let doc = json_of(&h.job_dir(&id).join(KEY).join("decide.json"));
    assert_eq!((&doc["audio"], &doc["decision"]["facts"]), (&expected["audio"], &expected["decision"]["facts"]));
    assert!(job_log(&h, &id).contains(&format!("{KEY}: decide inputs read back from the job folder")));
    assert_eq!(spawns_holding(&h, &["-/filter_complex"]).len(), 1, "the restart decodes nothing again");
}

#[test]
fn a_failed_ffmpeg_pass_is_decision_failed_with_its_class() {
    let h = harness(&["movie-direct-ffmpeg-error"], json!({}));
    let id = run_to(&h, "Failed");
    let record = h.record(&id);
    assert_eq!(record.state, State::Failed { class: FailureClass::Unknown, from: Box::new(State::Inspecting) });
    assert_eq!(
        record.message.as_deref(),
        Some("t00-00800: step 10a's ffmpeg pass failed (exit 1): title_t00.mkv: Invalid data found when processing input")
    );
    assert!(!h.job_dir(&id).join(KEY).join("decide.json").exists());
    assert!(!staged(&h, &id).join("streamhash.txt").exists());
    assert!(!work(&h, &id).exists());
}

#[test]
fn a_staging_share_that_stops_answering_during_step_10a_waits_as_awaiting_share() {
    let h = harness(&[], json!({}));
    h.insert("tok0", "movie-direct");
    h.run_until("Ejected");
    let id = h.job_ids().pop().unwrap();
    let tuning = staged(&h, &id);
    // The share goes away during the pass: the staged folder can take no file.
    h.on_spawn(&["0:a", "streamhash"], move || {
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&tuning);
        fs::write(&tuning, b"").unwrap();
    });
    h.shares().set_reach(&h.staging().display().to_string(), Reach::Unreachable("cable out".into()));
    h.restart();
    h.wait("AwaitingShare", |h| h.state_of(&id) == "AwaitingShare");
    assert_eq!(h.record(&id).state, State::AwaitingShare { return_to: Box::new(State::Inspecting) });
    assert!(events(&h, &id).iter().any(|e| matches!(e, Event::DecisionFailed { failure } if failure.class == FailureClass::Output)));
    assert!(h.job_dir(&id).join(KEY).join("streamhash.txt").is_file(), "the job folder's copy lands first");
}

#[test]
fn a_missing_ffmpeg_waits_as_tool_missing() {
    let h = harness(&[], json!({"tool_paths": {"ffmpeg": null}}));
    let id = run_to(&h, "AwaitingTool");
    h.settle();
    assert_eq!(h.record(&id).state, State::AwaitingTool { return_to: Box::new(State::Inspecting) });
    assert!(events(&h, &id).contains(&Event::ToolMissing { tool: Tool::Ffmpeg }));
    assert!(!h.job_dir(&id).join(KEY).join("decide.json").exists());
}

/// R5-code-33 (ENG-19): step 10a reads the job's own `keep_tuning_evidence`, not the engine's. The engine's settings
/// turn it off while the engine is stopped before Inspecting; the job keeps the settings it was made under.
#[test]
fn step_10a_follows_the_jobs_own_keep_tuning_evidence() {
    let h = harness(&[], evidence_on());
    h.insert("tok0", "movie-direct");
    h.run_until("Ejected");
    let id = h.job_ids().pop().unwrap();
    let path = h.data().join("settings.json");
    let mut settings = json_of(&path);
    settings["keep_tuning_evidence"] = json!(false);
    fs::write(&path, serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&settings).unwrap()).unwrap();
    h.restart();
    h.wait("Filed", |h| h.state_of(&id) == "Filed");
    assert_eq!(json_of(&path)["keep_tuning_evidence"], json!(false), "the engine's own setting stayed off");
    assert!(staged(&h, &id).join(LEVELS).join("audio-proxy.json").is_file());
    assert!(staged(&h, &id).join("audio-proxy.json").is_file());
    assert!(h.job_dir(&id).join(KEY).join(LEVELS).is_dir());
    assert!(!h.job_dir(&id).join(KEY).join("streamhash.txt").exists(), "no setting-off pass ran");
}

}
```

```rust
fn extract_subtitle_evidence(&self) -> Outcome {
    let failed = |failure| Event::DecisionFailed { failure };
    let plan = self.job_plan(failed)?;
    let (scan, typed) = self.planned_scan().map_err(|error| unknown(failed, error))?;
    let Some(ffmpeg) = self.tool(Tool::Ffmpeg) else {
        return Ok(event(Event::ToolMissing { tool: Tool::Ffmpeg }));
    };
    let Some(ffprobe) = self.tool(Tool::Ffprobe) else {
        return Ok(event(Event::ToolMissing { tool: Tool::Ffprobe }));
    };
    let staging = self.job.settings.staging_root.as_deref().ok_or_else(|| unknown(failed, "staging_root is unset"))?;
    for planned in &plan.titles {
        let key = planned.key.as_str();
        let raw = self.staged_file(key).map_err(|error| unknown(failed, error))?;
        let label_dir = self.job.job_dir.join(key);
        let tuning = tuning_dir(staging, self.id, key);
        let step10 = self.needs_step10(&scan, &typed, planned).map_err(|error| unknown(failed, error))?;
        if step10 {
            let Some(mkvmerge) = self.tool(Tool::Mkvmerge) else {
                return Ok(event(Event::ToolMissing { tool: Tool::Mkvmerge }));
            };
            // Task 15's worker check (OCR_MISSING); Task 14's staged_ident, evidence_file, step10::extract and its
            // unit_result; then Task 15's block from `let title_work` through its unit_result; all as they stand, over
            // this title's raw, label_dir and tuning (Task 15's own `let tuning` and `let label_dir` lines go).
        }
        let title_work = work_dir(&self.steps.work_root, WORK_KIND, self.id, key);
        let inputs = PassInputs {
            raw: &raw,
            job_id: self.id,
            key,
            label_dir: &label_dir,
            tuning: &tuning,
            title_work: &title_work,
            keep: self.job.settings.keep_tuning_evidence, // the job's own settings (R5-code-33)
        };
        let ended = self.ctx(&no_progress, |ctx| run_pass(ctx, &ffmpeg, &ffprobe, &inputs, &|line: &str| self.log(line)));
        self.check_cancel()?;
        match ended {
            Ok(PassEnd::Levels { folder, proxy_kept: true }) => self.log(&format!("{key}: step 10a wrote {folder}, proxy kept")),
            Ok(PassEnd::Levels { folder, proxy_kept: false }) => {
                self.log(&format!("{key}: step 10a wrote {folder}, no proxy kept"))
            }
            Ok(PassEnd::Streamhash) => self.log(&format!("{key}: step 10a wrote streamhash.txt")),
            Err(error) => return Ok(unit_result(error, || self.staging_health())),
        }
    }
    Ok(StepResult { event: None, message: None })
}
```

**Tier and risk:** opus; risk medium: the anti-goal of the notes' section 2 is a job that decodes an hour of a title twice because a lookup was slow, and the opposite fault, a skip over a folder that is not whole, decides with less evidence than the first run had and says nothing.
**Covers:** R1-evidence-28 (a complete staged folder skips steps 10 and 10a), R1-evidence-29 (an incomplete one is deleted and both steps run again), R1-evidence-30 and R1-evidence-31 (settled by T5-R12 and T5-R13: C3 reads the staged `subs-ocr\summary.json` and the staged level folder's own `audio-proxy.json`), R1-evidence-10 (the re-run's Decide reads the first unit's measures, MD5 (Message Digest 5) values, text and unread streams back, with the readers Tasks 15 and 17 gave `file_phase.rs`); R5-code-23, R5-code-24 (Decide's refetch failure in Inspecting is the retry C3 names); R6-phase0-61; Review Focus 3's torn move.

Precondition: Task 17 is pushed with CI (continuous integration) green on ubuntu, macos and windows and CodeQL at 0. From the trial's commit on, nothing under `crates/core/src/subtitle/bitmap/`, `crates/ocr/`, `crates/ocr-models/`, `crates/tools/src/ocr.rs`, `Cargo.toml` or `Cargo.lock` changes (T5-R54); this task edits none of them.

What this task builds: C3 of the notes (lines 83 to 88). Steps 10, 10a and 11 run as one unit (design part 5.2). A re-run of the unit happens in two ways: a retry after a Decide in Inspecting whose refetch of a stale TMDb (The Movie Database) copy failed (`LookupPending`, then AwaitingLookup, then `LookupAnswered` returns to Inspecting, whose `resume` runs Probe and then the unit again, core `job.rs:1090-1096` and `:823-825`), and a restart in Inspecting or in AwaitingLookup that returns there. Before a title's steps 10 and 10a, the unit asks whether its staged tuning folder `<staging>\<job id>\tuning\<title key>\` is complete. Complete is: with `keep_tuning_evidence` on, a level folder `audio-levels-20ms-*\` of the staged folder that holds its own `audio-proxy.json` (T5-R13: the file step 10a writes last there; the `audio-proxy.json` beside `audio-proxy.mka` does not count); with it off, `streamhash.txt` in the staged folder; and, for a title where step 10 runs, `subs-ocr\summary.json` in the staged folder (T5-R12: the staged copy is written after every stream's output has moved). A complete folder skips both steps for that title and Decide reads what the first unit left. An incomplete folder, and the job folder's own outputs of the two steps, are deleted, and both steps run again. A title with no staged folder runs both steps after the same deletion of the job folder's outputs, so a re-run never mixes two runs' files.

```rust
// engine::staged (notes C3; T5-R12, T5-R13)
pub(crate) const SKIPPED_COMPLETE: &str = "steps 10 and 10a skipped: the staged tuning folder is complete";
pub(crate) const CLEARED_INCOMPLETE: &str = "the staged tuning folder was incomplete, so it was deleted and steps 10 and 10a run again";
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) enum Staged { Complete, Incomplete, Absent }
pub(crate) fn staged_state(tuning: &Path, keep_tuning_evidence: bool, step10: bool) -> Staged;
pub(crate) fn clear_incomplete(tuning: &Path, label_dir: &Path) -> io::Result<()>;
```

`staged_state`: `Absent` when `tuning` is not a folder (a missing folder, or one the share does not answer for, which the steps then meet as a staging write error); otherwise `Complete` when the audio marker and, if `step10`, the subtitle marker are both files, else `Incomplete`. The audio marker with `keep_tuning_evidence` true is `<tuning>\<d>\audio-proxy.json` for some entry `<d>` of `tuning` that is a folder whose name starts with `audio-levels-20ms-`; with it false it is `<tuning>\streamhash.txt` (a level folder is then not looked at). The subtitle marker is `<tuning>\subs-ocr\summary.json`. A folder whose entries cannot be listed is `Incomplete`.

`clear_incomplete`: deletes `tuning` with everything under it, then under `label_dir` (the job folder's `<key>\`) the folder `subs-ocr\`, every folder whose name starts with `audio-levels-20ms-`, and the files `streamhash.txt`, `streamhash-ffmpeg.txt`, `streamhash-ffmpeg.txt.stderr`, `streamhash-ffmpeg.txt.timing.jsonl` and `streamhash-ffmpeg.txt.exit.json`. A path that does not exist is not an error; any other error is the `Err`, after which nothing more is deleted. Nothing else of the job folder is touched (`subs\`, `probe-summary.json`, `evidence-mkvmerge.txt`, the rip's files and `decide.json` stay; step 10's extraction writes its own files again), and `<staging>\<job id>\evidence\<key>.mks` stays (the extraction writes it again).

The step's use, at the head of each planned title's iteration in `extract_subtitle_evidence`, before anything of step 10 runs (after the loop's `let step10 = ...;` line and before its `if step10 {`, Task 17 Step 13): the loop's `step10`, `tuning` and `label_dir` for that title, the values it passes to `read_streams` and to `PassInputs`; then `match staged_state(&tuning, self.job.settings.keep_tuning_evidence, step10)`: `Complete` writes the job.log line `<key>: ` and `SKIPPED_COMPLETE` and goes to the next title; `Incomplete` calls `clear_incomplete`, writes `<key>: ` and `CLEARED_INCOMPLETE`, and runs both steps as Task 17 left them; `Absent` calls `clear_incomplete` with no line and runs both steps. A `clear_incomplete` error is `UnitError::Staging(format!("{}: the incomplete staged tuning folder could not be deleted: {error}", tuning.display()))`, which the loop classes by the share check as it classes every other `Staging` error (AwaitingShare or AwaitingSpace, never Unknown). Decide is unchanged: its inputs already come from the files the first unit left.

```rust
/// C3 (notes lines 83 to 88): a re-run of steps 10, 10a and 11 after a Decide in Inspecting whose refetch failed.
mod rerun {
    use super::*;

    /// keep_tuning_evidence on; the harness sets tuning_root to its scratch folder.
    fn on() -> Value {
        json!({"keep_tuning_evidence": true})
    }

    /// The job's ID, with `tmdb-record.json` made stale just before the job's first Probe, so the unit's Decide asks
    /// TMDb for it again (`movie-direct-two-subs-lookup-late` answers that ask with a timeout).
    pub(super) fn stale_before_the_probe(h: &Harness) -> String {
        let id = format!("{}-1", h.fingerprint("movie-direct").to_ascii_lowercase());
        let path = h.job_dir(&id).join("tmdb-record.json");
        h.on_spawn(&["-show_streams"], move || {
            let mut copy: Value = serde_json::from_slice(&fs::read(&path).unwrap()).unwrap();
            copy["fetched_at"] = json!("2026-01-01");
            fs::write(&path, serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&copy).unwrap()).unwrap();
        });
        id
    }

    /// The spawns of steps 10 and 10a: the worker, ffmpeg (not its `-version`), and mkvmerge's extraction into an
    /// `.mks` evidence file; each as its program's stem and its arguments.
    pub(super) fn unit_spawns(h: &Harness) -> Vec<String> {
        h.spawns()
            .into_iter()
            .filter_map(|s| {
                let stem = s.program.file_stem()?.to_str()?.to_string();
                let unit = match stem.as_str() {
                    "lazymkv-ocr" => true,
                    "ffmpeg" => !s.args.iter().any(|a| a == "-version"),
                    "mkvmerge" => s.args.iter().any(|a| a.ends_with(".mks")),
                    _ => false,
                };
                unit.then(|| format!("{stem} {}", s.args.join(" ")))
            })
            .collect()
    }

    fn workers(spawns: &[String]) -> usize {
        spawns.iter().filter(|s| s.starts_with("lazymkv-ocr ")).count()
    }

    /// What the job's first DecisionDone leaves: decide.json, the title's decision and the job's
    /// `subtitle_text_unread` notes, each with the harness's scratch root shown as `<root>`, so two harnesses compare.
    pub(super) fn decided(h: &Harness, id: &str) -> String {
        h.wait("DecisionDone", |h| events(h, id).iter().any(|e| matches!(e, Event::DecisionDone { .. })));
        let record = h.record(id);
        let unread: Vec<_> = record
            .notes
            .iter()
            .filter(|n| serde_json::to_value(&n.note).unwrap() == json!("subtitle_text_unread"))
            .collect();
        let text = [
            fs::read_to_string(h.job_dir(id).join(KEY).join("decide.json")).unwrap(),
            serde_json::to_string(&record.titles[0].decision).unwrap(),
            serde_json::to_string(&unread).unwrap(),
        ]
        .join("\n");
        let root = h.tools().parent().unwrap().display().to_string();
        text.replace(&root.replace('\\', "\\\\"), "<root>").replace(&root, "<root>")
    }

    pub(super) fn tuning(h: &Harness, id: &str) -> PathBuf {
        h.staging().join(id).join("tuning").join(KEY)
    }

    /// The one `audio-levels-20ms-*` folder of `dir`.
    pub(super) fn level_folder(dir: &Path) -> PathBuf {
        fs::read_dir(dir)
            .unwrap()
            .map(|e| e.unwrap().path())
            .find(|p| p.is_dir() && p.file_name().unwrap().to_str().unwrap().starts_with("audio-levels-20ms-"))
            .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("{}: no level folder", dir.display()))
    }

    fn job_log(h: &Harness, id: &str) -> String {
        fs::read_to_string(h.job_dir(id).join("job.log")).unwrap()
    }

    const SKIPPED: &str = "t00-00800: steps 10 and 10a skipped: the staged tuning folder is complete";
    const CLEARED: &str =
        "t00-00800: the staged tuning folder was incomplete, so it was deleted and steps 10 and 10a run again";

    #[test]
    fn a_retry_after_a_lookup_pending_decide_does_not_decode_again() {
        let baseline = harness(&["movie-direct-two-subs"], on());
        let base_id = run_to(&baseline, "Inspecting");
        let expected = decided(&baseline, &base_id);

        let h = harness(&["movie-direct-two-subs", "movie-direct-two-subs-lookup-late"], on());
        let id = stale_before_the_probe(&h);
        run_to(&h, "AwaitingLookup");
        let first = unit_spawns(&h);
        assert_eq!(workers(&first), 2, "{first:?}");
        assert!(events(&h, &id).contains(&Event::LookupPending));
        h.fire_timers();
        let got = decided(&h, &id);
        assert!(events(&h, &id).contains(&Event::LookupAnswered));
        assert_eq!(unit_spawns(&h), first, "steps 10 and 10a ran again");
        assert_eq!(job_log(&h, &id).matches(SKIPPED).count(), 1);
        assert_eq!(got, expected);
    }

    #[test]
    fn an_incomplete_staged_folder_is_deleted_and_both_steps_run_again() {
        let baseline = harness(&["movie-direct-two-subs"], on());
        let base_id = run_to(&baseline, "Inspecting");
        let expected = decided(&baseline, &base_id);

        let h = harness(&["movie-direct-two-subs", "movie-direct-two-subs-lookup-late"], on());
        let id = stale_before_the_probe(&h);
        run_to(&h, "AwaitingLookup");
        let first = unit_spawns(&h);
        let staged = tuning(&h, &id);
        fs::remove_file(level_folder(&staged).join("audio-proxy.json")).unwrap();
        fs::write(staged.join("leftover.txt"), b"x").unwrap();
        let job_subs = h.job_dir(&id).join(KEY).join("subs-ocr");
        fs::write(job_subs.join("leftover.txt"), b"x").unwrap();
        h.fire_timers();
        let got = decided(&h, &id);
        let second = unit_spawns(&h);
        assert_eq!(second.len(), 2 * first.len(), "{second:?}");
        assert_eq!(workers(&second), 4);
        assert!(!staged.join("leftover.txt").exists() && !job_subs.join("leftover.txt").exists());
        assert!(level_folder(&staged).join("audio-proxy.json").is_file());
        assert!(staged.join("subs-ocr").join("summary.json").is_file());
        assert_eq!(job_log(&h, &id).matches(CLEARED).count(), 1);
        assert!(!job_log(&h, &id).contains(SKIPPED));
        assert_eq!(got, expected);
    }

    #[test]
    fn with_the_setting_off_streamhash_txt_marks_the_folder_complete() {
        let h = harness(&["movie-direct-two-subs", "movie-direct-two-subs-lookup-late"], json!({}));
        let id = stale_before_the_probe(&h);
        run_to(&h, "AwaitingLookup");
        let staged = tuning(&h, &id);
        assert!(staged.join("streamhash.txt").is_file());
        assert!(fs::read_dir(&staged).unwrap().all(|e| {
            !e.unwrap().file_name().to_str().unwrap().starts_with("audio-levels-20ms-")
        }));
        let first = unit_spawns(&h);
        h.fire_timers();
        decided(&h, &id);
        assert_eq!(unit_spawns(&h), first, "steps 10 and 10a ran again");
        assert_eq!(job_log(&h, &id).matches(SKIPPED).count(), 1);
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_title_without_step_10_is_complete_without_summary_json() {
        let h = harness(&["movie-direct-two-subs-lookup-late"], on());
        let id = stale_before_the_probe(&h);
        run_to(&h, "AwaitingLookup");
        let staged = tuning(&h, &id);
        assert!(!staged.join("subs-ocr").exists(), "movie-direct has one English subtitle stream");
        assert!(level_folder(&staged).join("audio-proxy.json").is_file());
        let first = unit_spawns(&h);
        assert_eq!(workers(&first), 0);
        h.fire_timers();
```

```rust
const KEY: &str = "t00-00800";

fn tuning_on() -> serde_json::Value {
    json!({"keep_tuning_evidence": true, "drive_settle_s": 0, "drive_ready_timeout_s": 1})
}

/// The job's ID, with `tmdb-record.json` made stale just before the job's first Probe, so the unit's Decide asks TMDb
/// for it again.
fn stale_before_the_probe(h: &Harness) -> String {
    let id = format!("{}-1", h.fingerprint(DISC).to_ascii_lowercase());
    let path = h.job_dir(&id).join("tmdb-record.json");
    h.on_spawn(&["-show_streams"], move || {
        let mut copy: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_slice(&fs::read(&path).unwrap()).unwrap();
        copy["fetched_at"] = json!("2026-01-01");
        fs::write(&path, serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&copy).unwrap()).unwrap();
    });
    id
}

/// The spawns of steps 10 and 10a (the worker, ffmpeg but its `-version`, mkvmerge's extraction into an `.mks` file),
/// over the harness's whole life: its spawn list spans a restart.
fn unit_spawns(h: &Harness) -> Vec<String> {
    h.spawns()
        .into_iter()
        .filter_map(|s| {
            let stem = s.program.file_stem()?.to_str()?.to_string();
            let unit = match stem.as_str() {
                "lazymkv-ocr" => true,
                "ffmpeg" => !s.args.iter().any(|a| a == "-version"),
                "mkvmerge" => s.args.iter().any(|a| a.ends_with(".mks")),
                _ => false,
            };
            unit.then(|| format!("{stem} {}", s.args.join(" ")))
        })
        .collect()
}

fn workers(spawns: &[String]) -> usize {
    spawns.iter().filter(|s| s.starts_with("lazymkv-ocr ")).count()
}

/// decide.json, the title's decision and the `subtitle_text_unread` notes once the job's DecisionDone is persisted,
/// with the harness's scratch root shown as `<root>`.
fn decided(h: &Harness, id: &str) -> String {
    h.wait("DecisionDone", |h| {
        h.transitions(id).iter().any(|l| matches!(l.event, Some(Event::DecisionDone { .. })))
    });
    let record = h.record(id);
    let unread: Vec<_> = record
        .notes
        .iter()
        .filter(|n| serde_json::to_value(&n.note).unwrap() == json!("subtitle_text_unread"))
        .collect();
    let text = [
        fs::read_to_string(h.job_dir(id).join(KEY).join("decide.json")).unwrap(),
        serde_json::to_string(&record.titles[0].decision).unwrap(),
        serde_json::to_string(&unread).unwrap(),
    ]
    .join("\n");
    let root = h.tools().parent().unwrap().display().to_string();
    text.replace(&root.replace('\\', "\\\\"), "<root>").replace(&root, "<root>")
}

/// The decision of `scenarios` run straight through, with no failed refetch and no restart.
fn straight(scenarios: &[&str]) -> String {
    let h = harness(scenarios, tuning_on());
    let id = format!("{}-1", h.fingerprint(DISC).to_ascii_lowercase());
    h.insert("tok0", DISC);
    decided(&h, &id)
}

/// `scenarios` with the late lookup: the unit runs, Decide waits in AwaitingLookup, the engine restarts there.
fn restarted_in_awaiting_lookup(scenarios: &[&str]) -> (Harness, String) {
    let mut all = scenarios.to_vec();
    all.push("movie-direct-two-subs-lookup-late");
    let h = harness(&all, tuning_on());
    let id = stale_before_the_probe(&h);
    h.insert("tok0", DISC);
    h.wait("AwaitingLookup", |h| h.state_of(&id) == "AwaitingLookup");
    h.restart();
    (h, id)
}

#[test]
fn a_restart_with_a_complete_staged_folder_skips_steps_10_and_10a() {
    for scenarios in [&[DISC, "movie-direct-two-subs"][..], &[DISC, "movie-direct-two-subs", "movie-direct-two-subs-panic"][..]] {
        let expected = straight(scenarios);
        let (h, id) = restarted_in_awaiting_lookup(scenarios);
        let first = unit_spawns(&h);
        assert_eq!(workers(&first), 2, "{scenarios:?}: {first:?}");
        h.fire_timers();
        let got = decided(&h, &id);
        assert_eq!(unit_spawns(&h), first, "{scenarios:?}: steps 10 and 10a ran again after the restart");
        let log = fs::read_to_string(h.job_dir(&id).join("job.log")).unwrap();
        assert!(log.contains("t00-00800: steps 10 and 10a skipped: the staged tuning folder is complete"), "{log}");
        assert_eq!(got, expected, "{scenarios:?}");
    }
}

/// Review Focus 3: the engine stopped while it moved stream 1's output into the staged subs-ocr folder, after stream
/// 0's had landed. The unit persists no transition between its moves, so the test leaves the folder as that stop does.
#[test]
fn a_restart_after_a_torn_move_deletes_the_staged_folder_and_reads_again() {
    let expected = straight(&[DISC, "movie-direct-two-subs"]);
    let (h, id) = restarted_in_awaiting_lookup(&[DISC, "movie-direct-two-subs"]);
    let subs = h.staging().join(&id).join("tuning").join(KEY).join("subs-ocr");
    for file in ["summary.json", "sub-1.ocr.jsonl", "sub-1.run.json"] {
        fs::remove_file(subs.join(file)).unwrap();
    }
    fs::remove_dir_all(subs.join("s1")).unwrap();
    assert!(subs.join("sub-0.ocr.jsonl").is_file());
    let first = unit_spawns(&h);
    h.fire_timers();
    let got = decided(&h, &id);
    assert_eq!(workers(&unit_spawns(&h)), workers(&first) + 2, "both streams are read again");
    for file in ["summary.json", "sub-0.ocr.jsonl", "sub-1.ocr.jsonl"] {
        assert!(subs.join(file).is_file(), "{file}");
    }
    let log = fs::read_to_string(h.job_dir(&id).join("job.log")).unwrap();
    assert!(log.contains(
        "t00-00800: the staged tuning folder was incomplete, so it was deleted and steps 10 and 10a run again"), "{log}");
    assert_eq!(got, expected);
}
```

### Task 19: The dataset copy, its pending state and the cleanup's version-free rule (EVID-4, call 10, C2; T5-R13, T5-R14, T5-R46, T5-R55)

After the unit's Decide, the engine copies each title's staged tuning folder, with the title's evidence file, to `<tuning_root>\dataset\<job id>\<title key>\` on a thread of its own, outside the reducer, so an unreachable or full `tuning_root` never delays or fails the decision (design part 7.5, spec 7 "Tuning evidence", the notes' call 10). `state.json` gains `tuning_copy` (`pending` from the DecisionDone of a job whose own settings keep tuning evidence, `done` once every file has landed); the note `tuning_evidence_pending` is added only when an attempt finds `tuning_root` unreachable or short of space, and stays after the copy lands (T5-R14). A pending copy is retried at engine start, before any step starts and at each cleanup pass, and a retry only copies. The cleanup's interim of owner item 22 ends: a `Filed` job's staging data is held only while its copy is pending (C2), and engine.md's interim line is replaced in this commit (R5-code-88).

**Tier and risk:** opus (integration: a thread outside the reducer that writes `state.json` without a transition, the cleanup's hold, and the testkit's copy seam); risk high: a copy that marks `done` before its last file landed would let the cleanup delete the only copy of the bulky evidence, and one that holds `pending` for good would keep a job's raw data on the staging share for ever.

**Covers:** R1-evidence-7 (the note: an unreachable or full `tuning_root` adds `tuning_evidence_pending` and is no failure), 21 (the dataset tree's file names), 23 (setting off: nothing goes to `tuning_root`), 24 (outside the reducer), 25 (each file through `staged::copy_checked`), 26 (the level folder's `audio-proxy.json` last, in the dataset and then in the job folder; T5-R13), 27 (retried at engine start, before another step and at each cleanup pass; a retry only copies), 32 (the note and the copy's state in `state.json`, `lazymkv job v1`, notes sorted), 33 (settled by T5-R14: the cleanup reads `tuning_copy`, never the note), 34, 35, 36, 37, 38 (`the_cleanup_never_touches_tuning_root` stays); R3-worker-39 (the text reaches `<tuning_root>\dataset\` only with the setting on); R5-code-49 (the note is `Note::TuningEvidencePending` in `core::review`), 50, 51, 52, 53 (`CleanupJob.keep_tuning_evidence` removed), 56 (a title that kept no proxy counts its copy as done), 80 (no settings default changes: this task touches no `Settings` code), 88 (engine.md's interim line and the code change together); R6-phase0-44 (the dataset gets `sub-<n>.ocr.jsonl`, `sub-<n>.run.json`, `s<n>\f-<pts>.png` and `evidence.mks`); Review Focus 1.

```rust
        folders.write(&format!("{staged}/subs-ocr/sub-0.run.json"), "{}\n");
        folders.write(&format!("{staged}/subs-ocr/s0/f-000001000.png"), "png");
        folders.write(&format!("{staged}/subs-ocr/summary.json"), "{}\n");
        folders.write(&format!("staging/{ID}/evidence/{KEY}.mks"), "lazymkv-test-mks");

        fs::create_dir_all(folders.0.join("tuning")).unwrap();

            job_dir: folders.0.join("jobs").join(ID),
            staging_root: folders.0.join("staging").display().to_string(),

    /// `path` relative to `root`, with '/' separators.
    fn rel(root: &Path, path: &Path) -> String {
        path.strip_prefix(root).unwrap().to_str().unwrap().replace('\\', "/")
    }

    /// Every file under `dir`, relative, sorted; empty when `dir` does not exist.
    fn files(dir: &Path) -> Vec<String> {
        fn walk(root: &Path, dir: &Path, found: &mut Vec<String>) {
            let Ok(entries) = fs::read_dir(dir) else { return };
            for entry in entries {
                let path = entry.unwrap().path();
                if path.is_dir() {
                    walk(root, &path, found);
                } else {
                    found.push(rel(root, &path));
                }
            }
        }
        let mut found = Vec::new();
        walk(dir, dir, &mut found);
        found.sort();
        found
    }

        Ok(fs::metadata(to)?.len())
    }

            panic!("a missing staged folder beside a staged one is a failed copy");

        assert!(files(Path::new(&job.tuning_root)).is_empty());
    }

    /// C2: a job none of whose titles has a staged tuning folder owes nothing, as pull request 4's jobs and a job held
    /// under its build; a staging share that does not answer proves nothing, so that copy stays owed.
    #[test]
    fn a_job_with_no_staged_tuning_folder_owes_nothing() {
        let folders = Scratch::new("tuning-nothing");
        let job = staged_job(&folders);
        fs::remove_dir_all(staged(&job)).unwrap();
        let shares = FakeShares::new();
        assert_eq!(copy_dataset(&job, &shares, &AtomicBool::new(false), None), CopyEnd::Nothing);
        assert!(files(Path::new(&job.tuning_root)).is_empty());
        assert_eq!(shares.free_reads(&job.tuning_root), 0, "nothing owed asks tuning_root nothing");
        shares.set_reach(&job.staging_root, Reach::Unreachable("cable out".into()));
        let end = copy_dataset(&job, &shares, &AtomicBool::new(false), None);
        assert!(matches!(end, CopyEnd::Failed(_)), "{end:?}");
    }
}
```

```rust
//! The tuning dataset copy on stand-ins (design part 7.5, EVID-4; spec 7 "Tuning evidence"; call 10, C2; T5-R13,
//! T5-R14, T5-R46, T5-R55; Review Focus 1).

use std::collections::BTreeSet;
use std::ffi::OsStr;
use std::fs;
use std::io;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

use lazymkv_core::job::{Event, State, Tool};
use lazymkv_core::record::TuningCopy;
use lazymkv_core::review::Note;
use lazymkv_engine::testkit::Harness;
use lazymkv_platform::Reach;
use lazymkv_tools::exe_name;
use serde_json::{json, Value};

const KEY: &str = "t00-00800";
const COPIED: &str = "tuning evidence copied to tuning_root";
const DAY_MS: u64 = 86_400_000;

fn harness(variants: &[&str], settings: Value) -> Harness {
    let mut scenarios = vec!["movie-direct"];
    scenarios.extend_from_slice(variants);
    Harness::new(Path::new(env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_fake-tool")), &scenarios, settings)
}

fn on() -> Value {
    json!({"keep_tuning_evidence": true})
}

/// Inserts movie-direct in tok0 and returns the job's id.
fn insert(h: &Harness) -> String {
    h.insert("tok0", "movie-direct");
    format!("{}-1", h.fingerprint("movie-direct").to_ascii_lowercase())
}

/// Inserts movie-direct and waits for a persisted transition into `state`.
fn run_to(h: &Harness, state: &str) -> String {
    let id = insert(h);
    h.wait(state, |h| h.transitions(&id).iter().any(|line| line.new.as_str() == state));
    id
}

/// Waits until the job's state.json holds `copy` as its `tuning_copy`.
fn wait_copy_state(h: &Harness, id: &str, copy: TuningCopy) {
    h.wait("the copy's state", |h| h.job_ids().iter().any(|known| known == id) && h.record(id).tuning_copy == Some(copy));
}

/// Waits for the first copy attempt's line in job.log, then settles.
fn wait_first_attempt(h: &Harness, id: &str) {
    h.wait("a copy attempt's line", |h| !tuning_lines(h, id).is_empty());
    h.settle();
}

fn root(h: &Harness) -> String {
    h.tuning().display().to_string()
}

/// job.log's lines about the dataset copy, in order.
fn tuning_lines(h: &Harness, id: &str) -> Vec<String> {
    let log = fs::read_to_string(h.job_dir(id).join("job.log")).unwrap_or_default();
    log.lines().filter(|line| line.starts_with("tuning ")).map(str::to_string).collect()
}

fn staged(h: &Harness, id: &str) -> PathBuf {
    h.staging().join(id).join("tuning").join(KEY)
}

fn dataset(h: &Harness, id: &str) -> PathBuf {
    h.tuning().join("dataset").join(id).join(KEY)
}

/// The name of the one level folder `audio-levels-20ms-*` in `dir`.
fn level(dir: &Path) -> String {
    let names: Vec<String> = fs::read_dir(dir)
        .unwrap()
        .map(|entry| entry.unwrap().file_name().to_string_lossy().into_owned())
        .filter(|name| name.starts_with("audio-levels-20ms-"))
        .collect();
    assert_eq!(names.len(), 1, "{names:?}");
    names[0].clone()
}

/// Every file under `dir`, relative to it with '/' separators; empty when `dir` does not exist.
fn files_under(dir: &Path) -> BTreeSet<String> {
    fn walk(root: &Path, dir: &Path, found: &mut BTreeSet<String>) {
        let Ok(entries) = fs::read_dir(dir) else { return };
        for entry in entries {
            let path = entry.unwrap().path();
            if path.is_dir() {
                walk(root, &path, found);
            } else {
                found.insert(path.strip_prefix(root).unwrap().to_str().unwrap().replace('\\', "/"));
            }
        }
    }
    let mut found = BTreeSet::new();
    walk(dir, dir, &mut found);
    found
}

fn pending_notes(h: &Harness, id: &str) -> usize {
    h.record(id).notes.iter().filter(|noted| noted.note == Note::TuningEvidencePending).count()
}

/// The job's DecisionDone events, which name no scratch path, so two harnesses compare.
fn decisions(h: &Harness, id: &str) -> Vec<Event> {
    let found = h.transitions(id).into_iter().filter_map(|line| line.event);
    found.filter(|event| matches!(event, Event::DecisionDone { .. })).collect()
}

/// How many spawns ran the program `name` (the stand-in's file name).
fn runs_of(h: &Harness, name: &str) -> usize {
    h.spawns().iter().filter(|spawn| spawn.program.file_name() == Some(OsStr::new(name))).count()
}

fn ocr_worker() -> String {
    format!("lazymkv-ocr{}", std::env::consts::EXE_SUFFIX)
}

/// A job that went Filed with `tuning_root` unreachable, its copy pending, and the share answering again.
fn pending_then_reachable(h: &Harness) -> String {
    h.shares().set_reach(&root(h), Reach::Unreachable("cable out".into()));
    let id = run_to(h, "Filed");
    wait_first_attempt(h, &id);
    assert_eq!(h.record(&id).tuning_copy, Some(TuningCopy::Pending));
    h.shares().set_reach(&root(h), Reach::Reachable);
    id
}

/// T5-R46, R6-phase0-44: the dataset gets the staged folder whole and the evidence file from the staging evidence
/// folder, and the job folder's level folder gets its audio-proxy.json only when the copy lands (T5-R13).
#[test]
fn the_dataset_gets_evidence_mks_from_the_staging_evidence_folder() {
    let h = harness(&["movie-direct-two-subs"], on());
    let id = insert(&h);
    wait_copy_state(&h, &id, TuningCopy::Done);
    h.settle();
    let (staged, dataset) = (staged(&h, &id), dataset(&h, &id));
    let mut expected = files_under(&staged);
    expected.insert("subs-ocr/evidence.mks".to_string());
    assert_eq!(files_under(&dataset), expected);
    for file in files_under(&staged) {
        assert_eq!(fs::read(dataset.join(&file)).unwrap(), fs::read(staged.join(&file)).unwrap(), "{file}");
    }
    assert!(expected.contains("subs-ocr/sub-0.ocr.jsonl") && expected.contains("subs-ocr/sub-1.run.json"));
    let evidence = h.staging().join(&id).join("evidence").join(format!("{KEY}.mks"));
    assert_eq!(fs::read(dataset.join("subs-ocr").join("evidence.mks")).unwrap(), fs::read(&evidence).unwrap());
    assert!(!staged.join("subs-ocr").join("evidence.mks").exists());
    let level = level(&staged);
    let marker = h.job_dir(&id).join(KEY).join(&level).join("audio-proxy.json");
    assert_eq!(fs::read(&marker).unwrap(), fs::read(staged.join(&level).join("audio-proxy.json")).unwrap());
    assert_eq!(tuning_lines(&h, &id), [COPIED]);
    assert_eq!(pending_notes(&h, &id), 0, "a copy that lands at once adds no note (T5-R14)");
}

#[test]
fn an_unreachable_tuning_root_leaves_the_copy_pending_with_the_note_and_never_fails_the_decision() {
    let h = harness(&[], on());
    h.shares().set_reach(&root(&h), Reach::Unreachable("cable out".into()));
    let id = run_to(&h, "Filed");
    wait_first_attempt(&h, &id);
    let record = h.record(&id);
    assert_eq!(record.state, State::Filed);
    assert_eq!(record.tuning_copy, Some(TuningCopy::Pending));
    assert_eq!(pending_notes(&h, &id), 1);
    let found: Vec<Event> = h.transitions(&id).into_iter().filter_map(|line| line.event).collect();
    assert!(!found.iter().any(|event| matches!(event, Event::DecisionFailed { .. })), "{found:?}");
    assert_eq!(decisions(&h, &id).len(), 1);
    let lines = tuning_lines(&h, &id);
    assert_eq!(lines[0], format!("tuning copy pending: tuning_root {} did not answer: cable out", root(&h)));

    assert!(!h.job_dir(&id).join(KEY).join(level).join("audio-proxy.json").exists());

    wait_copy_state(&h, &id, TuningCopy::Done);
    h.settle();
    let dataset = dataset(&h, &id);
    assert!(!dataset.join("audio-proxy.mka").exists());
    assert!(dataset.join("audio-proxy.json").is_file());
    assert!(dataset.join(level(&staged(&h, &id))).join("audio-proxy.json").is_file());
    assert_eq!(tuning_lines(&h, &id), [COPIED]);
}

/// Review Focus 1: a `.partial` a lost connection left of another size is replaced at the next reach.
#[test]
fn a_partial_left_by_a_lost_share_is_replaced_and_the_copy_lands_at_the_next_reach() {
    let h = harness(&[], on());
    let id = pending_then_reachable(&h);
    let dataset = dataset(&h, &id);
    fs::create_dir_all(&dataset).unwrap();
    fs::write(dataset.join("audio-proxy.mka.partial"), b"torn").unwrap();
    assert_eq!(h.run_copies(), [id.clone()]);
    assert_eq!(fs::read(dataset.join("audio-proxy.mka")).unwrap(), fs::read(staged(&h, &id).join("audio-proxy.mka")).unwrap());
    assert!(files_under(h.tuning()).iter().all(|file| !file.ends_with(".partial")), "{:?}", files_under(h.tuning()));
    assert_eq!(h.record(&id).tuning_copy, Some(TuningCopy::Done));
    let lines = tuning_lines(&h, &id);
    assert_eq!(lines.iter().filter(|line| *line == COPIED).count(), 1, "{lines:?}");
    assert_eq!(lines.last().map(String::as_str), Some(COPIED));
    assert!(lines[..lines.len() - 1].iter().all(|line| line.starts_with("tuning copy ")), "{lines:?}");
}

/// Review Focus 1: a file whose size differs after the write is not renamed, the copy stays pending without the note
/// (it is neither spec 7 case), and the pending copy holds the staging data past retention (C2).
#[test]
fn a_copy_whose_size_differs_after_the_write_stays_pending_and_keeps_the_staging_data() {
    let h = harness(&[], on());
    h.copy_with(|from: &Path, to: &Path| -> io::Result<u64> {
        if to.file_name() == Some(OsStr::new("audio-proxy.mka.partial")) {
            let bytes = fs::read(from)?;
            fs::write(to, &bytes[..bytes.len() / 2])?;
            return Ok(bytes.len() as u64);
        }
        fs::copy(from, to)
    });
    let id = run_to(&h, "Filed");
    wait_first_attempt(&h, &id);
    assert_eq!(h.record(&id).tuning_copy, Some(TuningCopy::Pending));
    assert_eq!(pending_notes(&h, &id), 0);
    let (dataset, level) = (dataset(&h, &id), level(&staged(&h, &id)));
    assert!(!dataset.join("audio-proxy.mka").exists() && !dataset.join("audio-proxy.mka.partial").exists());
    assert!(!dataset.join(&level).join("audio-proxy.json").exists());
    assert!(!h.job_dir(&id).join(KEY).join(&level).join("audio-proxy.json").exists());
    let first = &tuning_lines(&h, &id)[0];
    assert!(first.starts_with("tuning copy pending: ") && first.contains(" bytes after the copy, not the "), "{first}");
    h.host().set_now_ms(1_792_800_000 * 1000 + 8 * DAY_MS);
    h.run_cleanup();
    assert!(staged(&h, &id).join("audio-proxy.mka").is_file(), "a pending copy holds the staging data");
}

/// Review Focus 1: a full tuning root is spec 7's "short of space": the note, a pending copy, the same decision.
#[test]
fn a_full_tuning_root_leaves_the_copy_pending_with_the_note_and_the_decision_unchanged() {
    let reference = harness(&[], on());
    let reference_id = run_to(&reference, "Filed");
    wait_copy_state(&reference, &reference_id, TuningCopy::Done);
    let h = harness(&[], on());
    h.shares().set_free(&root(&h), 10);
    let id = run_to(&h, "Filed");
    wait_first_attempt(&h, &id);
    assert_eq!(h.record(&id).tuning_copy, Some(TuningCopy::Pending));
    assert_eq!(pending_notes(&h, &id), 1);
    let first = &tuning_lines(&h, &id)[0];
    let head = format!("tuning copy pending: tuning_root {} has 10 bytes free, and the copy needs ", root(&h));
    assert!(first.starts_with(&head) && first.ends_with(" bytes"), "{first}");
    assert_eq!(decisions(&h, &id), decisions(&reference, &reference_id));
    assert!(!h.tuning().join("dataset").exists());
}

/// C2: a pending copy whose job has no staged tuning folder left owes nothing, as a job held under pull request 4's
/// build and approved under this one has none: the attempt ends the copy, and the cleanup deletes the staging data
/// once the job's retention has passed.
#[test]
fn a_pending_copy_with_no_staged_tuning_folder_owes_nothing_and_the_cleanup_deletes_the_staging_data() {
    let h = harness(&[], on());
    let id = pending_then_reachable(&h);
    fs::remove_dir_all(h.staging().join(&id).join("tuning")).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(h.run_copies(), [id.clone()]);
    assert_eq!(h.record(&id).tuning_copy, None);
    let last = tuning_lines(&h, &id).last().cloned();
    assert_eq!(last.as_deref(), Some("tuning copy: no staged tuning folder, so nothing is owed (C2)"));
    assert!(!h.tuning().join("dataset").exists());
    h.host().set_now_ms(1_792_800_000 * 1000 + 8 * DAY_MS);
    h.run_cleanup();
    assert!(!h.staging().join(&id).exists(), "nothing pending holds the staging data (C2)");
}

/// Call 10: on an idle engine a pending copy is retried at the cleanup pass once `tuning_root` answers again.
#[test]
fn a_pending_copy_is_retried_at_the_cleanup_pass_of_an_idle_engine() {
    let h = harness(&[], on());
    let id = pending_then_reachable(&h);
    h.run_cleanup();
    h.settle();
    assert_eq!(h.record(&id).tuning_copy, Some(TuningCopy::Done));
    assert_eq!(tuning_lines(&h, &id).last().map(String::as_str), Some(COPIED));
    assert!(staged(&h, &id).join("audio-proxy.mka").is_file(), "the job's retention has not passed, so its staging data stays");
}
```

### Task 20: The recordings refresh and the cleanup's mirror (design 7.5; call 11; T5-R15, T5-R16, T5-R40, T5-R57)

The engine gains design part 7.5's second tree: each time a job stops in `Filed`, `NeedsReview` or `Failed`, after its dataset copy lands, after a cleanup pass deleted one of its TMDb (The Movie Database) copies, and after a relayed command's refetch, a thread of its own copies the job folder's changed files into `<tuning_root>\recordings\<job id>\`, `state.json` included, so dev's refetch gate reads that folder as a job folder and fetches nothing there (G3). The refresh keeps a manifest of what it wrote, never writes the owner's three files, and deletes only a TMDb copy that its manifest lists and that the job folder no longer holds, which is how the cleanup's deletion is mirrored. The cleanup itself still never touches `tuning_root`.

**Tier and risk:** opus (integration: four triggers on the owner thread, a copy thread beside the reducer, and a manifest that decides the only deletion the tuning tree ever sees); risk medium: the refresh writes beside the owner's label files, so a wrong skip list or a deletion of an unlisted file destroys the owner's work, and a missed `state.json` would let dev's gate fetch into the mirror.

**Covers:** R1-evidence-21 (the recordings tree), 22 (no text under `recordings\`), 39 (the three states), 40, 41 (settled by T5-R15: `notes.md` is never written either), 42; R5-code-54 (the cleanup never touches `tuning_root`; the refresh mirrors it), 55, 64 (`state.json` mirrored, so `refresh_copies` fetches nothing in a recordings folder).

Precondition: Task 19 is committed, pushed and green on the three systems: `crates/engine/src/tuning.rs` exists with `TuningJob`, `copy_dataset` and its `mod tests`, `mod tuning;` is in `crates/engine/src/lib.rs`, `Msg::TuningCopied` persists `tuning_copy: done` when a copy lands, and `crates/fake-tools/tests/engine_tuning.rs` exists. This task edits no `Cargo.toml` and no `Cargo.lock`, and nothing under `crates/core/src/subtitle/bitmap/`, `crates/ocr/`, `crates/ocr-models/` or `crates/tools/src/ocr.rs` (T5-R54).

A refresh that copies writes no line, so a stopped job's job.log does not grow at every refresh.

  1. The sources: every regular file under `job_dir` (`symlink_metadata`; a link or a junction is neither followed nor copied), as a path relative to `job_dir` with `/` separators, skipping a file whose name is one of `OWNER_FILES` or `REFRESH_MANIFEST` at any depth, or ends in `TEMP_SUFFIX` or `staged::PARTIAL`; sorted by that path, then `state.json` moved first when present. A read error of a folder is the call's `Err`.
  2. The manifest: `target/REFRESH_MANIFEST` parsed as `Manifest`; a missing file, a parse error or a `format` other than `REFRESH_FORMAT` is an empty manifest.
  3. `fs::create_dir_all(target)`.
  4. Deletions: each entry whose `path` is one of `TMDB_COPIES` (the folder's top level only) and whose `job_dir/<path>` is `NotFound` has `target/<path>` removed (`NotFound` ignored), leaves the manifest and goes to `deleted`. Every other entry stays, its target file untouched, whether or not its source still exists.
  5. Copies, for each source in step 1's order: read its metadata (`bytes` the length, `modified_ns` from `modified()` since `UNIX_EPOCH`, 0 for an earlier time); it is copied when the manifest has no entry for its path, the entry's `bytes` or `modified_ns` differs, or `target/<path>` does not exist. A copy is `fs::create_dir_all` of the target's parent and then `staged::copy_checked(source, target/<path>)`; the entry is then replaced or added with the metadata of this step, and `copied` counts it.
  6. The manifest, sorted by `path`, written through `write_atomic` as `serde_json::to_vec_pretty` plus `\n`; then `Ok(RefreshEnd { copied, deleted })`.
  An error in step 3, 4 or 5 writes the manifest as in step 6 with the entries landed so far (a failure to write it is ignored) and returns the first error, as `io::Error::new(error.kind(), format!("{}: {error}", path.display()))` with the path that failed. `tuning.rs`' source-scan entry in `staged.rs`' test (Task 19) keeps passing: the only copy is `copy_checked`.

```rust
    fn none() -> StepScript { StepScript::Result(StepResult { event: None, message: None }) }

    fn main_line() -> Vec<(&'static str, StepScript)> {

            ("RunScan", step(Event::ScanDone)), ("Plan", step(Event::PlanDone { mode: Mode::Direct })),
            ("CheckSpace", step(Event::SpaceOk)), ("RipTitle", step(Event::TitleRipped)),
            ("VerifyFile", step(Event::TitleVerified { last: true })), ("Eject", step(Event::Ejected)),
            ("Probe", step(Event::ProbeDone)), ("ExtractSubtitleEvidence", none()),
            ("Decide", step(Event::DecisionDone { disposition: Disposition::AutoFile, reasons: vec![], has_path: true })),
            ("CheckSpace", step(Event::SpaceOk)), ("Remux", step(Event::RemuxDone)),
            ("VerifyFile", step(Event::FileVerified)), ("File", step(Event::FileDone)),
        ]
    }

    /// The main line up to its first `tag`, whose script is `last`; nothing after it.
    fn line_to(tag: &str, last: StepScript) -> Vec<(&'static str, StepScript)> {
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        for (t, s) in main_line() {
            if t == tag {
                out.push((t, last));
                return out;
            }
            out.push((t, s));
        }
        panic!("no {tag} in the main line")
    }

    /// The harness's one job, once `DISC` is in tok0 and the job is in `state`.
    fn job_in(h: &Harness, state: &str) -> String {
        h.insert("tok0", DISC);
        h.wait(&format!("the job in {state}"), |h| h.job_ids().first().is_some_and(|id| h.state_of(id) == state));
        h.job_ids().pop().unwrap()
    }

    fn walk(dir: &Path) -> Vec<PathBuf> {
        let mut found = Vec::new();
        let mut folders = vec![dir.to_path_buf()];
        while let Some(folder) = folders.pop() {
            let Ok(entries) = fs::read_dir(&folder) else { continue };
            for entry in entries {

        assert!(job_log(&h).contains(line), "{}", job_log(&h));
        assert!(!mirror(&h, &id).exists());
        assert_eq!(h.state_of(&id), "NeedsReview", "a failed refresh holds nothing");
        h.shares().set_reach(&root, Reach::Reachable);
        fs::write(h.job_dir(&id).join("tmdb.json"), copy("2026-01-01")).unwrap();
        let before = h.refreshes(&id);
        h.run_cleanup(); // the next trigger: the pass deleted a TMDb copy of the job
        refreshed(&h, &id, before + 1);
        assert!(mirror(&h, &id).join("state.json").is_file());
        assert!(fs::read_to_string(mirror(&h, &id).join("job.log")).unwrap().contains(line));
    }

    #[test]
    fn the_recordings_tree_holds_counts_and_no_subtitle_text() {
        let runs: [&[&str]; 2] = [&["movie-direct-two-subs"], &["movie-direct-two-subs", "movie-direct-two-subs-panic"]];
        for scenarios in runs {
            let h = Harness::new(Path::new(env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_fake-tool")), scenarios, keeping());
            h.insert("tok0", "movie-direct-two-subs");
            h.wait("the job stops", |h| {
                h.job_ids().first().is_some_and(|id| ["Filed", "NeedsReview", "Failed"].contains(&h.state_of(id).as_str()))
            });
            let id = h.job_ids().pop().unwrap();
            refreshed(&h, &id, 1);
            h.settle();
            let files = walk(&h.tuning().join("recordings"));
            assert!(files.iter().any(|path| path.ends_with("state.json")), "{scenarios:?}: {files:?}");
            assert!(files.iter().any(|path| path.ends_with("subs-ocr/summary.json")), "{scenarios:?}: {files:?}");
            for path in &files {
                let name = path.file_name().unwrap().to_string_lossy().into_owned();
                let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&fs::read(path).unwrap()).into_owned();
                assert!(!text.contains(SENTINEL), "{}", path.display());
                for refused in [".ocr.jsonl", ".run.json", ".png", ".mks"] {
                    assert!(!name.ends_with(refused), "{}", path.display());
                }
                assert!(!name.contains(".capture.txt"), "no worker capture: {}", path.display());
                if path.parent().unwrap().file_name().unwrap() == "subs-ocr" {
                    let count = name == "summary.json" || (name.starts_with("sub-") && name.ends_with(".frames.json"));
                    assert!(count, "only the counts under subs-ocr: {}", path.display());
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

In `crates/fake-tools/tests/engine_command.rs`, after `a_relayed_decide_with_a_stale_copy_it_cannot_fetch_exits_3_and_leaves_the_job_alone`:

```rust
/// Design part 7.5: a relayed command's refetch changes the job folder, so the recordings are refreshed after it. The
/// job ran with the setting off and has it turned on in its own settings.json, so no copy or earlier refresh exists.
#[test]
fn a_relayed_decide_refetch_is_mirrored_into_the_recordings_tree() {
    let (h, id) = filed();
    let job = h.job_dir(&id);
    let mut own = json_of(&job.join("settings.json"));
    own["keep_tuning_evidence"] = json!(true);
    fs::write(job.join("settings.json"), serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&own).unwrap()).unwrap();
    h.restart(); // the owner reads the job's own settings when it loads the job
    let mirror = h.tuning().join("recordings").join(&id);
    assert!(!mirror.exists());
    stale(&h, &id, "tmdb-record.json");
    let mut c = client(&h);
    let (_, reply) = c.command(&["decide", "--job", &id, "--title", KEY]);
    assert_eq!(reply, exit(0, 1));
    assert_ne!(json_of(&job.join("tmdb-record.json"))["fetched_at"], json!("2026-01-01"), "the refetch replaced it");
    h.wait("the refresh after the refetch", |h| h.refreshes(&id) >= 1);
    assert_eq!(fs::read(mirror.join("tmdb-record.json")).unwrap(), fs::read(job.join("tmdb-record.json")).unwrap());
    assert!(mirror.join("state.json").is_file());
}
```

```rust
// crates/dev/src/cmd/retune.rs (design part 7.7; D1, D2; call 12; T5-R29 to T5-R31, T5-R53)
const USAGE: &str = "retune [--evidence DIR[=TEXTDIR] ...] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--snapshot FILE] [--compare FILE] [--spec FILE] [--allow-unmeasured] [--subtitles] [--text DIR]";
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) struct EvidenceArg { pub(crate) dir: String, pub(crate) text: Option<String> }
pub(crate) fn split_evidence(value: &str) -> EvidenceArg; // split at the first '='; no '=' gives text None
pub(crate) fn worst(codes: &[i32]) -> i32; // 3 if any is 3, else 1 if any is 1, else 0; 3 for an empty list (D2)
/// The section body of a folder with no labels file of the harness run (D2). Def: T5-21. Use: T5-21.
pub const NO_LABELLED_TRACK: &str = "no labelled track";
pub(crate) fn single_only(flag: &str) -> String; // "argument {flag}: only with a single --evidence", and for "--text" that text plus "; give DIR=TEXTDIR" (T5-R29)
pub(crate) const TEXT_WITH_TEXTDIR: &str = "argument --text: not with --evidence DIR=TEXTDIR, which names the text already"; // T5-R53
pub(crate) fn section_header(k: usize, m: usize, shown: &str) -> String; // "evidence folder {k} of {m}: {shown}", shown the DIR half as given
fn refresh_evidence(ctx: &Ctx, evidence: &Path, shown_root: &str, err: &mut dyn Write) -> Result<(), i32>; // each child shown "{shown_root}/{name}"

// crates/dev/src/stale.rs (T5-R40, call 25)
/// `lazymkv-dev retune: <shown>/<file>: unmeasured: the TMDb copy is missing or more than six months old (fetched_at
/// <date>), and a job folder's copy is fetched again only by lazymkvctl retune --jobs`; `(no fetched_at)` replaces
/// `(fetched_at <date>)` when the copy has none. Def: T5-21. Use: T5-21, T5-22.
pub fn unmeasured_line(shown: &str, copy: &StaleCopy) -> String;
pub(crate) fn stale_job_folders(ctx: &Ctx, evidence: &Path) -> Vec<(String, StaleCopy)>; // (child name, its first stale copy)

// crates/dev/src/evidence.rs
impl DiskTree { pub(crate) fn open_without(root: &Path, display_root: &str, left_out: &[String]) -> std::io::Result<DiskTree>; }
```

`stale_job_folders`: every child folder of `evidence` but `.git`, in name order, that holds `JOB_STATE_FILE`; for each, `stale_copies(<its lookup-status.txt as UTF-8 with a leading U+FEFF dropped, "" when absent>, &|name| fs::read(<folder>.join(name)).ok(), true, &today)`; a folder with a non-empty list is returned with the list's first copy (`TMDB_COPIES` order). `today` is `ctx.today()`, read once and only when a job folder is found (the clock is a PowerShell start on Windows). `open_without` is `open` with the named top-level child folders not walked, as `.git` is not; `open` calls it with `&[]`.

```rust
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Several evidence folders (design part 7.7; notes D1, D2, calls 12 and 25; Rulings T5-R29 to T5-R31, T5-R40,
// T5-R53). Every folder is made up here, from the fixtures above (RP21).

mod several {
    use super::super::{single_only, split_evidence, worst, EvidenceArg, NO_LABELLED_TRACK, TEXT_WITH_TEXTDIR, USAGE};
    use super::*;

    /// Ctx::for_test's day is 2026-10-13: a copy fetched 2026-01-01 is more than six months old.
    const STALE: &str = "2026-01-01";

    /// The main corpus in `<tmp>/<name>`, exit 0 alone; its path as an argument.
    fn ok_folder(tmp: &TempDir, name: &str) -> String {
        build_main_corpus(&tmp.0.join(name));
        tmp.path(name)
    }

    /// The main corpus with disc-b's all-tracks stream 3 labelled alternate-mix (programme audio), which gets the
    /// commentary verdict: exit 1 alone.
    fn failing_folder(tmp: &TempDir, name: &str) -> String {
        build_main_corpus(&tmp.0.join(name));
        write_labels(&tmp.0.join(name).join("disc-b"), vec![entry("all-tracks", 3, "alternate-mix")], json!({}));
        tmp.path(name)
    }

    /// The main corpus with a label of disc-b's all-tracks stream 7, which no level folder measures: exit 3 alone.
    fn unmeasured_folder(tmp: &TempDir, name: &str) -> String {
        build_main_corpus(&tmp.0.join(name));
        let slug = tmp.0.join(name).join("disc-b");
        let data = read_json_file(&slug.join("audio-labels.json"));
        let mut tracks = data["tracks"].as_array().unwrap().clone();
        tracks.push(entry("all-tracks", 7, "foreign-dub"));
        write_labels(&slug, tracks, data["titles"].clone());
        tmp.path(name)
    }

    /// One level folder and no audio-labels.json anywhere.
    fn unlabelled_folder(tmp: &TempDir, name: &str) -> String {
        let s = signals();
        Folder::new("mu", &[(2, &s.comment[..], "cu")]).write(&tmp.0.join(name).join("disc-u/t0"));
        tmp.path(name)
    }

    /// The main corpus with fit-disc's label in no vocabulary: exit 2 alone.
    fn bad_labels_folder(tmp: &TempDir, name: &str) -> String {
        build_main_corpus(&tmp.0.join(name));
        write_labels(&tmp.0.join(name).join("fit-disc"), vec![entry("t0", 3, "comentary")], json!({}));
        tmp.path(name)
    }

    /// `retune --evidence <folder> ... --spec <tmp>/spec.md <extra>`: (exit code, stdout, stderr).
    fn over(tmp: &TempDir, folders: &[&str], extra: &[&str]) -> (i32, String, String) {
        let spec = tmp.path("spec.md");
        let mut args: Vec<&str> = Vec::new();
        for folder in folders {
            args.extend(["--evidence", *folder]);
        }
        args.push("--spec");
        args.push(spec.as_str());
        args.extend_from_slice(extra);
        call(tmp, &args)
    }

    /// The single-folder run over `folder` once it has settled: run twice, so the second reads the baseline the first
    /// wrote, as a several-folder run then reads it.
    fn settled(tmp: &TempDir, folder: &str) -> (i32, String, String) {
        over(tmp, &[folder], &[]);
        over(tmp, &[folder], &[])
    }

    /// A folder's section in a run of `m` folders, from its settled single-folder stdout: the header, then that stdout
    /// without its "snapshot:" line.
    fn section_from(k: usize, m: usize, folder: &str, single_out: &str) -> String {
        let body: String =
            single_out.lines().filter(|line| !line.starts_with("snapshot: ")).map(|line| format!("{line}\n")).collect();
        format!("evidence folder {k} of {m}: {folder}\n{body}")
    }

    #[test]
    fn evidence_dir_equals_textdir_splits_at_the_first_equals_sign() {
        let arg = |dir: &str, text: Option<&str>| EvidenceArg { dir: dir.to_string(), text: text.map(str::to_string) };
        assert_eq!(split_evidence("corpus/owner"), arg("corpus/owner", None));
        assert_eq!(
            split_evidence(r"T:\tuning\recordings=T:\tuning\dataset"),
            arg(r"T:\tuning\recordings", Some(r"T:\tuning\dataset"))
        );
        assert_eq!(split_evidence("a=b=c"), arg("a", Some("b=c")));
    }

    #[test]
    fn the_exit_code_is_the_worst_over_the_folders() {
        assert_eq!(worst(&[0, 1, 0]), 1);
        assert_eq!(worst(&[1, 3, 0]), 3);
        assert_eq!(worst(&[3, 1]), 3);
        assert_eq!(worst(&[0, 0]), 0);
        assert_eq!(worst(&[]), 3, "no folder with labels (D2)");
        let tmp = new_tmp("several-worst");
        let (ok, fail, unmeasured) =
            (ok_folder(&tmp, "ok"), failing_folder(&tmp, "fail"), unmeasured_folder(&tmp, "unmeasured"));
        assert_eq!(over(&tmp, &[ok.as_str()], &[]).0, 0);
        assert_eq!(over(&tmp, &[fail.as_str()], &[]).0, 1);
        assert_eq!(over(&tmp, &[unmeasured.as_str()], &[]).0, 3);
        let runs: [(&[&str], i32); 5] = [
            (&[ok.as_str(), fail.as_str()], 1),
            (&[fail.as_str(), ok.as_str()], 1),
            (&[ok.as_str(), unmeasured.as_str()], 3),
            (&[unmeasured.as_str(), fail.as_str()], 3),
            (&[ok.as_str(), ok.as_str()], 0),
        ];
        for (folders, code) in runs {
            let (got, out, err) = over(&tmp, folders, &[]);
            assert_eq!(got, code, "{folders:?}\n{out}{err}");
        }
        assert_eq!(over(&tmp, &[ok.as_str(), unmeasured.as_str()], &["--allow-unmeasured"]).0, 0);
    }

    #[test]
    fn two_evidence_folders_give_two_sections_in_flag_order() {
        let tmp = new_tmp("several-sections");
        let (a, b) = (ok_folder(&tmp, "a"), failing_folder(&tmp, "b"));
        let (code_a, out_a, err_a) = settled(&tmp, &a);
        let (code_b, out_b, err_b) = settled(&tmp, &b);
        assert_eq!((code_a, code_b, err_a.as_str(), err_b.as_str()), (0, 1, "", ""));
        let baselines = |tmp: &TempDir| ["a", "b"].map(|name| fs::read(tmp.0.join(name).join(BASELINE_FILE)).unwrap());
        let before = baselines(&tmp);
        let expected = format!("{}\n{}", section_from(1, 2, &a, &out_a), section_from(2, 2, &b, &out_b));
        assert_eq!(over(&tmp, &[a.as_str(), b.as_str()], &[]), (1, expected, String::new()));
        let reversed = format!("{}\n{}", section_from(1, 2, &b, &out_b), section_from(2, 2, &a, &out_a));
        assert_eq!(over(&tmp, &[b.as_str(), a.as_str()], &[]), (1, reversed, String::new()));
        assert_eq!(baselines(&tmp), before, "a several-folder run writes no baseline (T5-R31)");
        assert_eq!(fs::read_dir(tmp.0.join("tmp")).unwrap().count(), 0, "and no trial or unchecked snapshot");
    }

    #[test]
    fn snapshot_or_compare_with_two_evidence_folders_is_an_argument_error() {
        let tmp = new_tmp("several-snapshot");
        let (a, b) = (tmp.path("a"), tmp.path("b")); // never read: the arguments are refused first
        let file = tmp.path("s.json");
        for flag in ["--snapshot", "--compare"] {
            let refused = format!("usage: lazymkv-dev {USAGE}\nlazymkv-dev retune: error: {}\n", single_only(flag));
            assert_eq!(over(&tmp, &[a.as_str(), b.as_str()], &[flag, file.as_str()]), (2, String::new(), refused), "{flag}");
        }
        assert!(!tmp.0.join("s.json").exists());
        assert_eq!(single_only("--snapshot"), "argument --snapshot: only with a single --evidence");
        assert_eq!(single_only("--compare"), "argument --compare: only with a single --evidence");
        assert_eq!(single_only("--text"), "argument --text: only with a single --evidence; give DIR=TEXTDIR");
        assert_eq!(TEXT_WITH_TEXTDIR, "argument --text: not with --evidence DIR=TEXTDIR, which names the text already");
    }

    #[test]
    fn an_evidence_textdir_half_is_ignored_without_subtitles() {
        let tmp = new_tmp("several-textdir");
        let (a, b) = (ok_folder(&tmp, "a"), failing_folder(&tmp, "b"));
        let nowhere = tmp.path("no-text"); // never made: the audio harness reads no OCR text
        let single = settled(&tmp, &a);
        assert_eq!(over(&tmp, &[format!("{a}={nowhere}").as_str()], &[]), single);
        let both = over(&tmp, &[a.as_str(), b.as_str()], &[]);
        assert_eq!(both.0, 1);
        let (a_text, b_text) = (format!("{a}={nowhere}"), format!("{b}={nowhere}"));
        assert_eq!(over(&tmp, &[a_text.as_str(), b_text.as_str()], &[]), both);
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_folder_without_labels_reads_no_labelled_track_and_keeps_the_exit_code() {
        assert_eq!(NO_LABELLED_TRACK, "no labelled track");
        let tmp = new_tmp("several-unlabelled");
        let (ok, fail, none) = (ok_folder(&tmp, "ok"), failing_folder(&tmp, "fail"), unlabelled_folder(&tmp, "none"));
        let (_, out_ok, _) = settled(&tmp, &ok);
        let (code, out, err) = over(&tmp, &[ok.as_str(), none.as_str()], &[]);
        assert_eq!((code, err.as_str()), (0, ""), "{out}");
        assert_eq!(out, format!("{}\nevidence folder 2 of 2: {none}\nno labelled track\n", section_from(1, 2, &ok, &out_ok)));
        assert_eq!(over(&tmp, &[none.as_str(), fail.as_str()], &[]).0, 1);
        assert!(!tmp.0.join("none").join(BASELINE_FILE).exists());
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_run_with_no_labels_in_any_folder_exits_3() {
        let tmp = new_tmp("several-no-labels");
        let (x, y) = (unlabelled_folder(&tmp, "x"), unlabelled_folder(&tmp, "y"));
        let expected = format!("evidence folder 1 of 2: {x}\nno labelled track\n\nevidence folder 2 of 2: {y}\nno labelled track\n");
        assert_eq!(over(&tmp, &[x.as_str(), y.as_str()], &[]), (3, expected, String::new()));
        assert_eq!(over(&tmp, &[x.as_str(), y.as_str()], &["--allow-unmeasured"]).0, 3, "--allow-unmeasured makes no label");
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_folder_whose_labels_do_not_validate_exits_2_at_once() {
        let tmp = new_tmp("several-bad-labels");
        let (ok, bad) = (ok_folder(&tmp, "ok"), bad_labels_folder(&tmp, "bad"));
        let (code, out_bad, _) = over(&tmp, &[bad.as_str()], &[]);
        assert_eq!(code, 2, "{out_bad}");
        let (_, out_ok, _) = settled(&tmp, &ok);
        assert_eq!(
            over(&tmp, &[bad.as_str(), ok.as_str()], &[]),
            (2, format!("evidence folder 1 of 2: {bad}\n{out_bad}"), String::new())
        );
        assert_eq!(
            over(&tmp, &[ok.as_str(), bad.as_str()], &[]),
            (2, format!("{}\nevidence folder 2 of 2: {bad}\n{out_bad}", section_from(1, 2, &ok, &out_ok)), String::new())
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_missing_evidence_folder_stops_the_run_before_any_section() {
        let tmp = new_tmp("several-missing");
        let ok = ok_folder(&tmp, "ok");
        let absent = tmp.path("absent");
        let line = format!(
            "{absent}: no such folder; the evidence repository lazymkv-evidence is not cloned there (git clone https://github.com/krcm0209/lazymkv-evidence {absent})\n"
        );
        assert_eq!(over(&tmp, &[ok.as_str(), absent.as_str()], &[]), (3, String::new(), line));
    }

    #[test]
    fn the_baseline_check_runs_only_for_a_folder_holding_audio_dataset_json() {
        let tmp = new_tmp("several-baseline");
        let (a, b) = (ok_folder(&tmp, "a"), ok_folder(&tmp, "b"));
        settled(&tmp, &a);
        let baseline = fs::read(tmp.0.join("a").join(BASELINE_FILE)).unwrap();
        let (code, out, err) = over(&tmp, &[a.as_str(), b.as_str()], &[]);
        assert_eq!((code, err.as_str()), (0, ""), "{out}");
        let (first, second) = out.split_once(&format!("\nevidence folder 2 of 2: {b}\n")).expect("two sections");
        assert!(first.contains("Changes since the previous snapshot ("), "{first}");
        assert!(!second.contains("Changes since the previous snapshot"), "{second}");
        assert_eq!(fs::read(tmp.0.join("a").join(BASELINE_FILE)).unwrap(), baseline);
        assert!(!tmp.0.join("b").join(BASELINE_FILE).exists(), "a several-folder run writes no baseline (T5-R31)");
    }

    #[test]
    fn each_folders_refetch_lines_name_that_folder() {
        let tmp = new_tmp("several-refetch");
        let (a, b) = (ok_folder(&tmp, "a"), ok_folder(&tmp, "b"));
        write(&tmp.0.join("b/disc-s/lookup-status.txt"), "tmdb movie/6537 200\r\n");
        write(
            &tmp.0.join("b/disc-s/tmdb.json"),
            format!(r#"{{"id": 6537, "title": "Made Up Film", "original_language": "es", "fetched_at": "{STALE}"}}"#),
        );
        let line = |shown: &str| {
            format!("{shown}/disc-s/tmdb.json: the TMDb copy is more than six months old (fetched_at 2026-01-01) and TMDB_TOKEN is not set to fetch it again\n")
        };
        assert_eq!(over(&tmp, &[a.as_str(), b.as_str()], &[]), (3, String::new(), line(b.as_str())));
        assert_eq!(over(&tmp, &[b.as_str()], &[]), (3, String::new(), line("corpus/owner")), "one folder is shown as today");
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_job_shaped_folder_with_a_stale_copy_is_unmeasured_and_never_exits_3() {
        let tmp = new_tmp("several-job-stale");
        let corpus = ok_folder(&tmp, "corpus");
        let (code, out, err) = settled(&tmp, &corpus);
        assert_eq!((code, err.as_str()), (0, ""), "{out}");
        let s = signals();
        for (slug, main, cand) in [("job-j", "mj", "cj"), ("job-k", "mk", "ck")] {
            let dir = tmp.0.join("corpus").join(slug);
            Folder::new(main, &[(3, &s.comment[..], cand)]).write(&dir.join("t0"));
            // Read, this label would fail the run (exit 1): a programme track with the commentary verdict.
            write_labels(&dir, vec![entry("t0", 3, "alternate-mix")], json!({}));
            write(&dir.join("state.json"), "{}");
        }
        write(
            &tmp.0.join("corpus/job-j/tmdb.json"),
            format!(r#"{{"id": 6537, "title": "Made Up Film", "original_language": "es", "fetched_at": "{STALE}"}}"#),
        );
        // job-k's copy was answered and then deleted: missing.
        write(&tmp.0.join("corpus/job-k/lookup-status.txt"), "tmdb movie/6537 200\r\n");
        let lines = |shown: &str| {
            format!(
                "lazymkv-dev retune: {shown}/job-j/tmdb.json: unmeasured: the TMDb copy is missing or more than six months old (fetched_at 2026-01-01), and a job folder's copy is fetched again only by lazymkvctl retune --jobs\n\
                 lazymkv-dev retune: {shown}/job-k/tmdb.json: unmeasured: the TMDb copy is missing or more than six months old (no fetched_at), and a job folder's copy is fetched again only by lazymkvctl retune --jobs\n"
            )
        };
        assert_eq!(over(&tmp, &[corpus.as_str()], &[]), (0, out, lines("corpus/owner")));
        let other = ok_folder(&tmp, "other");
        let (code, several, err) = over(&tmp, &[other.as_str(), corpus.as_str()], &[]);
        assert_eq!((code, err), (0, lines(corpus.as_str())), "{several}");
        assert!(!several.contains("job-j") && !several.contains("job-k"), "{several}");
    }
}
```

### Task 22: retune --jobs, decide's --text and retune's absolute paths through the relay

The relay stops refusing `retune --jobs` (Ruling W25's `RETUNE_WAITS` goes, notes call 13): it builds `retune --evidence <tuning_root>\recordings=<tuning_root>\dataset` and then the client's words, so a client's own `--evidence` accumulates after the engine's (G2), and before the child starts it fetches every stale or missing TMDb (The Movie Database) copy of the recordings tree, into the engine job folder and then across by the refresh for a job the engine holds, and into the recordings folder itself for an orphan (G3, call 25). A relayed `decide --job --title` gains `--text <tuning_root>\dataset` once the job's dataset copy has landed (call 14, T5-R14). `lazymkvctl` makes a relayed retune's path flags absolute (V10, call 13): `--snapshot`, `--compare` and `--text` are sent again made absolute, as plan's and decide's are, and each relative `--evidence` value, both halves of `DIR=TEXTDIR` included, is replaced in place, since an appended copy of a flag that accumulates would read a folder twice.

**Tier and risk:** opus (integration: the owner's command path, a thread of its own, the share and three crates); risk high: the relayed child is an elevated `lazymkvctl` whose words the engine builds, the refetch before it writes into the engine's job folders and the owner's tuning tree, and a refetch that ends after the child starts lets the child read a copy mid-write.

**Covers:** R1-evidence-43 (an engine job's stale copy fetched into its job folder, refreshed across, exit 3 without a token), 44 (the orphan), 45 (the child words verbatim, `RETUNE_WAITS` removed), 46 (`--evidence` accumulates), 48 (the engine layout `<tuning_root>\dataset\<job id>\<title key>\subs-ocr\` that the `--evidence` TEXTDIR half and decide's `--text` name), 53 (decide's `--text`); R4-commands-40 to 51; R5-code-64 (the relayed run, not dev's gate, refreshes a recordings folder), 65 to 72.

Precondition: Task 21 is committed, pushed and green on ubuntu, macos and windows with CodeQL (the code scanning service) at 0. This task edits no `Cargo.toml` and no `Cargo.lock`, and nothing under `crates/core/src/subtitle/bitmap/`, `crates/ocr/`, `crates/ocr-models/` or `crates/tools/src/ocr.rs` (T5-R54). Line numbers below are as of `07ccc48`; Tasks 13, 15, 19, 20 and 21 edit `owner.rs`, `relay.rs`, `testkit.rs` and `retune.rs` first, so each named item is found where they left it.

Decisions this task settles (each goes into the code's docs as written here):

- "The job's dataset copy exists" is `JobRecord.tuning_copy == Some(TuningCopy::Done)` (T5-R14), read by the owner when it builds the words; the `--text` path is `<tuning_root>\dataset` with the engine's settings in force, the same `tuning_root` `retune --jobs` names (design part 9.5's table).
- A `tuning_root` that is absent, empty or only spaces is unset, as `Settings::validate` reads it, and `retune --jobs` is then refused with `RETUNE_NO_TUNING_ROOT` (T5-R32).
- The relayed retune's refetch runs on its own thread (`spawn_retune_refetch`), which lists `<tuning_root>\recordings` itself, so the owner thread never lists the share. A recordings folder whose name is a job the owner holds is that job's mirror; any other folder is an orphan (call 25). A recordings folder that does not exist lists no folder.
- An engine job's refusal names the job: `job <id>: <reason>`, the reasons of several jobs joined with `"; "`; the reply is then `STALE_EXIT` (3) and no child runs (R4-commands-44). A refresh that fails after a refetch is such a refusal too (`job <id>: the recordings copy could not be refreshed: <error>`), since the child would read the stale mirror.
- An orphan's outcome never refuses the run: a copy fetched again gives the standard-error line `<folder>: the TMDb copy <file> was fetched again`, and a copy not fetched gives `<folder>: <stale sentence>; retune reports the folder as unmeasured` (Task 21 reports it so, T5-R40). These lines reach the client as `lazymkvctl: <line>` before the child's lines, or before the exit 3 line.
- `lazymkvctl` places the made-absolute `--spec` it already sends (K7) at the first `--`, as V10 places its added words, instead of after it.
